jobs.title: Analyst - Contracts Management (CORS35)
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Specialist - Contract Management to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will be responsible for managing the contract lifecycle to support our innovative projects across the entertainment and recreational sectors. Your expertise will ensure contracts are well-structured, compliant, and aligned with Qiddiya's strategic objectives.

Position Summary

The Procurement Lead serves as the single point of contact for an assigned business sector, overseeing the end-to-end procurement lifecycle from purchase request intake through contract execution. This role directs a team of buyers, ensures timely and compliant handling of competitive RFPs, and partners closely with sector stakeholders to resolve procurement queries and drive value through strategic sourcing and vendor negotiation.

Key Responsibilities

  • Act as the primary point of contact for procurement matters within the assigned sector, fielding and resolving queries on a daily basis
  • Receive, review, and process all categories of Purchase Requests, including competitive RFPs, Work Orders, Variations, and Single Source Orders
  • Lead, assign, and guide a team of buyers, ensuring workload is distributed effectively and purchase requests are actioned in coordination with multiple business sectors
  • Manage competitive RFP packages from initiation through award and contract signature
  • Negotiate and execute high-value, high-complexity contract agreements in alignment with organizational risk and value objectives
  • Coordinate with key users and suppliers to arrange supplier presentations, technical clarifications, and Q&A sessions
  • Draft, review, and amend contract agreements in close collaboration with Legal and Insurance functions to ensure compliance
  • Develop and implement procurement execution plans, including schedules, procedures, and risk assessment methodology
  • Conduct supplier pre-qualification and monitor market pricing, escalating fluctuations that affect budget or supply continuity
  • Identify continuous improvement opportunities across the procurement process to enhance efficiency and business outcomes

Requirements

    • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, Engineering, Law, or a related discipline.
    • Minimum of 5 years of experience in procurement, strategic sourcing, or contract management, with demonstrated experience managing end-to-end procurement activities.
    • Proven experience in competitive tendering (RFPs), supplier negotiations, contract drafting, and contract administration for high-value procurement projects.
    • Strong knowledge of procurement policies, commercial risk management, supplier evaluation, and procurement best practices.
    • Demonstrated leadership experience with the ability to manage, mentor, and coordinate procurement teams while handling multiple priorities.
    • Excellent stakeholder management, communication, and negotiation skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively across Legal, Finance, Technical, and Business functions.
    • Proficiency in ERP procurement systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, or equivalent) and Microsoft Office Suite

Benefits

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Accounts Payable
jobs.description:

You will lead the accounts payable processes, ensuring all invoices and payments are processed accurately and timely while fostering strong relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Assets Infrastructure Delivery

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Cloud Operation
jobs.description:
The Assistant Manager – Cloud Operations is responsible for supporting the day-to-day operation, reliability, governance, security, and optimization of Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP) environments. The role works closely with infrastructure, security, application, service desk, vendors, managed service providers, and business stakeholders to ensure cloud services are stable, secure, resilient, cost-effective, and aligned with business requirements.

The role also supports Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) practices, including service availability, monitoring, incident response, reliability improvement, automation, and operational excellence.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities

  • Support daily cloud operations across Microsoft Azure and Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Monitor cloud infrastructure health, availability, performance, capacity, and incidents.
  • Support SRE practices, including reliability monitoring, availability improvement, incident response, service health reviews, and operational automation.
  • Manage incident response, service requests, escalations, and root cause analysis for cloud services.
  • Support implementation and maintenance of cloud governance, policies, standards, tagging, and compliance controls.
  • Review and optimize cloud cost, usage, reserved capacity, rightsizing, and resource cleanup.
  • Coordinate with vendors, managed service providers, and internal teams to resolve operational issues.
  • Support native backup, disaster recovery, high availability, and business continuity activities.
  • Maintain cloud documentation, operational runbooks, architecture diagrams, and knowledge base articles.
  • Support cloud security operations, including IAM reviews, network security, patching, vulnerability remediation, encryption, and access governance.
  • Assist with automation and Infrastructure as Code adoption using tools such as Terraform.
  • Track operational KPIs such as availability, incident resolution, SLA compliance, policy violations, cost optimization, reliability metrics, and documentation coverage.
  • Participate in change management, release coordination, and operational readiness reviews.
  • Support audits, compliance reviews, and risk remediation related to Azure and GCP cloud infrastructure.

Required Skills and Experience

  • Minimum 5 years of hands-on experience in cloud operations, cloud engineering, infrastructure operations, SRE, or related technical roles.
  • Hands-on knowledge of Microsoft Azure and/or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
  • Understanding of cloud networking, identity, compute, storage, monitoring, backup, security, and high availability.
  • Experience with incident, problem, change, and service request management.
  • Familiarity with SRE concepts, including availability, reliability, monitoring, alerting, incident response, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement.
  • Familiarity with ITIL processes and IT service management tools.
  • Good understanding of cloud security, IAM, RBAC, network security groups/firewalls, encryption, vulnerability management, and compliance controls.
  • Ability to work with vendors, managed service providers, and cross-functional teams.
  • Strong troubleshooting, communication, documentation, and stakeholder coordination skills.
  • Experience with automation or scripting using tools such as Terraform, PowerShell, or Python is preferred.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Cybersecurity Threat Management

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Finance and Procurement Operations Business Partner
jobs.description:
The Assistant Manager – Finance and Procurement Operations Business Partner supports the Marketing function in managing its financial planning, procurement activities, vendor relationships, and operational requirements. The role acts as the main coordination point between Marketing and Finance, Procurement, Legal, and external suppliers to ensure budgets, purchase requests, contracts, purchase orders, and payments are managed efficiently and in accordance with organizational policies.

Requirements

Financial Planning and Budget Management

  • Support the preparation and management of the Marketing department’s annual budget and financial plans.
  • Work with Marketing teams to forecast spending requirements across campaigns, events, media, sponsorships, agencies, and other activities.
  • Monitor actual spending, commitments, and available budgets against approved plans.
  • Prepare regular budget reports, forecasts, variance analyses, and financial updates for Marketing leadership.
  • Identify potential budget risks, overspending, underspending, and funding gaps, and recommend appropriate actions.
  • Support budget transfers, reallocations, accruals, and year-end financial closing activities.
  • Ensure accurate allocation of costs across Marketing functions, projects, campaigns, and cost centres.

Procurement Operations

  • Coordinate procurement requirements for marketing campaigns, events, media services, creative agencies, production services, research, and other marketing activities.
  • Support the preparation and submission of purchase requisitions, requests for proposals, tender documents, and purchase orders.
  • Work with Marketing stakeholders to develop clear scopes of work, technical requirements, deliverables, and commercial evaluation criteria.
  • Track procurement activities from initial request through sourcing, evaluation, contracting, purchase order issuance, and payment.
  • Ensure procurement requests are supported by the required approvals and documentation.
  • Maintain visibility of procurement timelines and follow up on delayed or outstanding actions.

Vendor and Contract Management

  • Coordinate the onboarding and registration of new Marketing vendors and agencies.
  • Maintain accurate records of vendor contracts, purchase orders, deliverables, payment schedules, and contract expiry dates.
  • Monitor vendor performance against agreed service levels, deliverables, timelines, and budgets.
  • Support contract renewals, amendments, extensions, and closure activities.
  • Coordinate with Procurement and Legal to address contractual, commercial, or supplier-related matters.
  • Support the resolution of vendor disputes, delayed deliverables, invoice discrepancies, and payment issues.

Invoice and Payment Management

  • Review invoices and supporting documents to confirm alignment with contracts, purchase orders, and completed deliverables.
  • Coordinate with Marketing teams to obtain confirmation of services and approvals before processing payments.
  • Track invoices and payments and follow up with Finance, Procurement, and vendors on outstanding items.
  • Maintain accurate records of financial commitments, invoices, accruals, and payment status.
  • Support the timely resolution of blocked, rejected, or incorrectly submitted invoices.

Business Partnering and Stakeholder Management

  • Act as the main operational link between Marketing and Finance, Procurement, Legal, and other corporate functions.
  • Advise Marketing stakeholders on relevant financial, procurement, and contracting processes.
  • Support Marketing teams in planning procurement lead times and selecting the appropriate sourcing approach.
  • Facilitate regular budget and procurement review meetings with Marketing stakeholders.
  • Provide clear updates to management on budget status, procurement progress, risks, and required decisions.
  • Build effective relationships with internal teams, agencies, suppliers, and service providers.

Governance, Compliance and Reporting

  • Ensure all Marketing financial and procurement activities comply with organizational policies, delegated authorities, and approval requirements.
  • Maintain complete and accurate documentation to support governance reviews and internal or external audits.
  • Develop and maintain trackers, dashboards, reports, and operational records for budgets, contracts, purchase orders, and payments.
  • Identify process gaps and recommend improvements to increase efficiency, visibility, and compliance.
  • Support the development of standardized templates, guidelines, and working procedures for Marketing operations.
  • Monitor key operational indicators, including procurement turnaround time, budget utilization, payment status, and vendor performance.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Procurement, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
  • Professional certification in Finance, Procurement, Supply Chain, or Project Management is an advantage.
  • Minimum of 4–6 years of relevant experience in finance operations, procurement, commercial operations, business partnering, or budget management.
  • Previous experience supporting a Marketing, Communications, Events, Media, or Sponsorships function is preferred.
  • Experience managing budgets, purchase requisitions, purchase orders, contracts, invoices, and vendor relationships.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Investment Management - 20012292
jobs.description:
Qiddiya has an opportunity for an Investment Management professional to join our team and play a pivotal role in evaluating, originating, and managing real estate investment opportunities.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role where you will collaborate closely with senior leadership to identify new investment opportunities, originate deals, and structure transactions. You will be expected to apply your expertise in financial modelling, corporate finance, and M&A to build the backbone of our investment framework and manage the financial performance of our real estate investments.

We are looking for a candidate with a strong background in investment management and financial modelling, ideally someone with experience in corporate finance, real estate investment, and private equity.

At the heart of our investment strategy, you will engage in market research, perform rigorous financial due diligence, and create sophisticated models to assess the profitability and risks of potential investments. You will work closely with both internal teams (including project managers, analysts, and associates) and external stakeholders (including banks, consultants, and legal advisors) to ensure the success of each project. Your ability to understand and implement complex financial structures and deal terms will be essential to driving long-term growth and profitability for the company.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and is eager to contribute to the strategic direction of a company at a pivotal stage in its growth journey.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • MBA, CFA, or equivalent qualifications preferred.
  • Strong technical expertise in banking or investment management is essential.

Experience:

  • +5 years in investment management, financial modelling, or M&A advisory (preferably in real estate or private equity).
  • Experience in corporate finance, M&A modelling, and deal structuring, with a focus on real estate.
  • Strong experience from boutique investment banks (e.g., Lazar, Rothschild, Jefferies) or large real estate funds (e.g., Hines, Brookfield, Capital Land).
  • Prior exposure to the GCC region is highly desirable.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in financial modelling, Excel, and corporate finance.
  • Familiarity with banking terminology and M&A processes.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of real estate investment strategies, trends, and market conditions in the GCC region.
  • Understanding of portfolio management and investment analysis.

Language Skills:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - IT Demand Management
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

Change and Release Control

  1. Review, assess, and validate change and release requests to identify potential risks, conflicts, dependencies, and overall business impact.
  2. Facilitate and govern Change Advisory Board (CAB) and Emergency Change Advisory Board (ECAB) meetings, ensuring informed decision-making for both changes and releases, with clear accountability and approval outcomes.
  3. Own and maintain the  Change & Release Calendar, ensuring alignment between planned changes, release windows, blackout periods, and business-critical events to minimize service disruption.
  4. Plan, coordinate, and govern software and infrastructure releases across environments (DEV, SIT, UAT, PROD), ensuring readiness, approvals, and adherence to agreed release windows.
  5. Ensure all Changes and releases meet Change and release readiness criteria, including testing evidence, rollback plans, risk assessments, security approvals, and business sign-off prior to production deployment.
  6. Maintain accurate and auditable change and release documentation, including requests, approvals, release notes, implementation steps, rollback procedures, and post-release outcomes.
  7. Monitor and analyze Change & Release Management KPIs (e.g., change success rate, emergency changes, release failure rate, rollback frequency), identifying trends, risks, and opportunities for continuous improvement.
  8. Conduct and govern Post-Implementation Reviews (PIRs) for changes and releases, ensuring lessons learned are captured, corrective actions are tracked, and systemic issues are addressed.
  9. Support internal and external audits related to IT Change and Release Management by providing evidence, process compliance, and improvement actions.
  10. Work closely with IT operations, development teams, business units, cybersecurity, QA, and third-party vendors to coordinate change and release activities end-to-end.
  11. Provide clear, timely communication on change and release status, risks, dependencies, and impact assessments to all relevant stakeholders, including management and business owners.
  12. Enforce adherence to Change & Release Management policies, standards, and governance frameworks, ensuring alignment with ITIL best practices and organizational controls.

10. 10-capture the dispositions of the demand items and ensure they move into their next phase based on those outcomes

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information System or a related field.

Experience

  • Between 5+ years of experience in in IT Change Management, IT Change & Release Management, or IT Service Management roles.

Certifications

  • ITIL Foundation certification

Technical Skills

·       Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills

·       Highly organized with excellent time management skills

jobs.title: Assistant Manager - Supply Chain Risks
jobs.description:
Role Overview:

Requirements

·   Identify potential risks in the supply chain and assess the likelihood and impact of the risks using risk assessment frameworks, (e.g., operational, financial, ESG, compliance, geopolitical, cybersecurity, capacity, and concentration risks).

·  Support implementation of mitigation strategies and contingency plans to manage the identified risks and ensure business continuity.

Qualifications:

jobs.title: Associate Director - Cybersecurity Risk and Compliance

This role will focus on providing expert legal guidance related to regulatory compliance and employment matters, ensuring that the company operates within the framework of applicable laws and best practices in human resources.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide strategic legal advice on labor laws, employment regulations, and regulatory requirements affecting the company’s operations.
  • Draft, review, and advise on employment contracts, policies, and procedures to ensure compliance with local and international labor laws.
  • Support management in resolving complex employee relations issues, disputes, and disciplinary matters.
  • Stay abreast of legal developments in labor and employment law and assess their impact on the company.
  • Collaborate with HR and other departments to ensure legal risks are managed effectively across employee lifecycle processes.
  • Represent the company in regulatory matters related to employment and liaise with governmental authorities as required.
  • Conduct training and workshops for management and employees to raise awareness on regulatory compliance and employment best practices.
  • Mentor junior legal staff and promote a culture of legal excellence within the team.

Requirements

  • Legal qualification with admission to practice law.
  • Minimum of 12 years’ experience specializing in regulatory and employment law, preferably in a corporate or in-house legal environment.
  • In-depth knowledge of labor laws, employment regulations, and regulatory compliance in relevant jurisdictions.
  • Proven ability to manage complex employee relations and regulatory compliance issues.
  • Strong drafting, negotiation, and advisory skills in employment and regulatory matters.
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in both Arabic and English.
  • Demonstrated leadership abilities, including mentoring and guiding junior legal team members.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment handling multiple priorities.

jobs.title: Commercial Director - City Operations (DEL 5)
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a dynamic and experienced Commercial Director for City Operations (DEL 5) to drive the commercial strategy and execution for our city-wide operations. This leadership role requires a commercially astute professional to manage all commercial facets of city operations projects, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya’s strategic goals and commitment to excellence.

The Commercial Director will lead contract negotiations, procurement, financial management, and risk mitigation activities across diverse operational areas. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to optimize commercial performance, maintain budgetary discipline, and foster strong relationships with partners and stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of commercial strategies for contracts related to Operations within Qiddiya
  • Lead all post-contract commercial management across City Ops (variations, claims, compliance, performance)
  • Define and execute contract renewal and cost optimization strategies across key service contracts
  • Provide commercial insight on risks, commitments, and forecast impact, aligned within Commercial and Reporting and Finance
  • Leading the implementation of the Service charge framework and model and costs recovery process across operating assets
  • Act as commercial lead to City Ops leadership, supporting ExCom/MC decision-making and building team capability
  • Provide mentorship and guidance to the commercial team, fostering a culture of excellence and continuous improvement

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Quantity Surveying, Business Administration, Construction Management, or a related field; advanced degree preferred.
  • At least 12 years of progressive experience in commercial/contract management within the operations (O&M, FM, utilities, city operations) or construction sectors.
  • Professional accreditation such as MRICS or FRICS is highly desirable.
  • Demonstrated experience in managing large-scale Operations with a focus on commercial contract negotiation and management.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication, negotiation, and interpersonal skills to effectively engage with a diverse range of stakeholders.
  • Proven leadership abilities with experience in developing and mentoring junior staff.
  • Strong expertise in post-contract management (variations, claims, renewals, performance management).

Benefits

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

jobs.title: Delivery Management
jobs.description:
The Manager - IT Delivery Managment is responsible for ensuring that technology/Digital products, projects, and services are delivered successfully from initiation to production. The role acts as the bridge between business stakeholders, product teams, technology teams, vendors, architecture, cybersecurity, operations, and executive management. The Delivery Manager owns the end-to-end delivery process, ensuring scope, budget, quality, timelines, risks, dependencies, and stakeholder expectations are effectively managed.

jobs.title: Delivery Project Manager / Construction Manager
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a dynamic Delivery Project Manager to lead the successful delivery of our construction projects within the vibrant Qiddiya development. You will play a crucial role in managing construction activities, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget, while meeting the highest quality standards. This role involves close collaboration with contractors, consultants, and internal teams to drive.

Key Responsibilities

    • Plan, coordinate, and manage all construction delivery activities to ensure alignment with project timelines, budgets, and quality requirements.
    • Oversee construction contracts and liaise with contractors to monitor progress, address issues, and enforce compliance with safety and quality standards.
    • Develop and implement construction methodologies, risk mitigation strategies, and problem-solving approaches to ensure smooth project execution.
    • Lead regular site inspections, progress meetings, and reporting to track construction status and address any deviations.
    • Collaborate with design, procurement, and project management teams to ensure seamless integration between design and construction phases.

Benefits

Comprehensive benefits package

jobs.title: Director - Architecture - Hospitality - 20013111 HS8
jobs.description:
At Qiddiya Investment Company, we are shaping a landmark destination redefining entertainment, culture and hospitality in the Kingdom. The Hospitality Business Unit is developing a portfolio of hotel assets central to this vision. As these assets progress, we are seeking experienced professionals to help deliver them to the highest standards of design quality, guest experience and commercial performance.

In this role, you will lead the creative architectural design agenda across the hospitality portfolio, defining design principles and shaping hotel concepts from development brief to endorsed design direction, while overseeing consultants and ensuring design integrity, technical compliance and performance are maintained through delivery.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the architectural definition of hotel concepts from development brief to approved design direction, curating distinctive, emotive and commercially viable responses aligned with Qiddiya, district and Operator visions
  • Articulate and position architectural design proposals to secure alignment and timely outcomes through key governance stages
  • Define architectural design principles, typologies and performance benchmarks for each hotel tier, establishing consistent and validated design baselines across the portfolio
  • Oversee consultant briefing and scope definition, validating architectural scope and specialist inputs to ensure alignment with development briefs, asset positioning, Operator requirements and governance approvals
  • Oversee visualisation and design communication (including CGI strategy), ensuring concepts are clearly articulated and aligned with design narratives and stakeholder expectations
  • Lead and govern architecture and specialist consultants, driving strategic approaches on appointment, scope and deliverables and overseeing performance, quality and creative alignment
  • Provide functional governance to project-embedded design management teams, reviewing and endorsing architectural deliverables to ensure approved design intent is maintained through delivery
  • Lead technical input to development briefs, shaping planning efficiency, gross-to-net ratios, spatial configuration and system integration for hospitality assets
  • Drive integrated coordination across architecture, interiors, landscape and technical disciplines, resolving interfaces and ensuring cohesive design outcomes
  • Lead structured review of design submissions across key milestones, providing clear feedback and endorsement to support design progression
  • Provide creative and technical design oversight through design and construction, resolving interfaces and deviations to maintain design quality and intent
  • Guide value engineering and design optimisation, balancing design intent, guest experience and asset performance
  • Champion sustainability and climate-responsive design, embedding ESG and Vision 2030 priorities
  • Mentor teams and drive continuous improvement of design processes, standards and best practices

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Architecture or related discipline

Professional Certifications

  • Professional membership or recognised certification preferred (e.g. RIBA, AIA, RICS or equivalent)

 Years of Experience

  • 15+ years’ experience in architectural design with a strong hospitality focus across luxury and mixed-tier projects

Skills & Attributes Required

  • Strong architectural design literacy, judgement and technical review capability across all project stages
  • Fluent understanding of hospitality planning (areas, efficiencies etc.) and building systems (structural, MEP integration etc.)
  • Ability to manage consultants and influence design outcomes
  • Commercial awareness of cost and programme impacts
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, articulating design intent to secure alignment and drive decision-making
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity and shifting priorities
  • Proficiency in design management and coordination tools (e.g. Revit, BIM, CDE platforms, Aconex, Autodesk Construction Cloud etc.)

Preferred Background & Experience

  • Experience in a senior design leadership role (Design Director, Principal or similar) within a major architecture practice or developer environment
  • Proven track record of managing architect and multi-disciplinary consultant environments across multiple projects
  • Strong experience presenting architectural concepts to senior stakeholders and Operators
  • Experience working with international hotel Operators and brand standards
  • Experience in KSA / GCC or similar large-scale development environments preferred

jobs.title: Director - Asset Application Operations
jobs.description:
The Director – Asset Application Operations is responsible for managing the operations, configuration, governance, and continuous availability of asset and park applications across the Qiddiya portfolio. This includes Vista and VGS ticketing and point-of-sale platforms, Maximo, ERD/Yardi, and all park- and complex-related applications, ensuring system availability, data accuracy, revenue integrity, and compliance with safety, leasing, and PCI DSS standards.

The role oversees ticketing, guest-facing, maintenance, leasing, and QHSE application operations to maintain guest experience continuity, asset reliability, lifecycle visibility, and operational integration across parks, sports, entertainment, and complex venue

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage day-to-day operations of Vista and VGS ticketing, admission, and point-of-sale platforms across Qiddiya entertainment venues.
  • Govern product, pricing, capacity, promotions, and season-pass configurations through controlled change management.
  • Ensure integration between ticketing, POS, access control, CRM, payment gateways, and ERP systems.
  • Oversee daily reconciliation of ticketing and POS revenue with Finance.
  • Ensure PCI DSS compliance for payment processing and cardholder data.
  • Lead peak-day, major-event, and degraded-mode operational readiness, including load testing and command center support.
  • Manage Maximo and ERD/Yardi environments supporting maintenance and leasing operations.
  • Validate work orders, preventive maintenance schedules, asset hierarchies, tenant information, and lease transactions.
  • Maintain standardized master data for assets, locations, tenants, and contracts.
  • Manage release calendars and outage windows to minimize operational disruption.
  • Oversee operations of all park and complex applications, including F&B and retail POS, access control, RFID/cashless systems, lockers, virtual queuing, ride operations, and guest mobile applications.
  • Maintain the application portfolio, support model, and venue-specific SLAs.
  • Coordinate major incident management and event-day operational support with Park Operations.
  • Ensure application readiness for seasonal operations, new attractions, and venue openings through onboarding, integration testing, and hypercare.
  • Ensure QHSE checklists, incident records, and corrective actions are maintained within applications.
  • Prepare and maintain audit-ready documentation, including SOPs, operational controls, and supporting evidence.
  • Monitor statutory inspections, certifications, renewals, and compliance dashboards.
  • Collaborate with Safety and Engineering teams to enhance workflows and compliance processes.
  • Monitor KPIs and dashboards for asset downtime, maintenance backlog, lease performance, revenue reconciliation, and SLA compliance.
  • Oversee reconciliation of ERD revenue with Finance and resolve discrepancies.
  • Maintain application governance controls, including access, change, and data quality management.
  • Ensure operational documentation, knowledge bases, and support procedures remain current.
  • Manage vendor support queues and prioritize issues based on business criticality.
  • Deliver user training and operational guidance for inspections, work orders, lease amendments, and renewals.
  • Manage UAT planning, execution, approvals, and release readiness.
  • Monitor vendor SLAs, escalation processes, and service handovers across application support teams.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field; Master's preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in asset, park, or ticketing application operations.
  • ITIL certification or equivalent required.
  • Experience with Maximo and ERD/Yardi.
  • Experience with Vista and VGS ticketing and POS platforms.
  • Knowledge of integrations across ticketing, access control, CRM, ERP, and payment systems.
  • Knowledge of PCI DSS, revenue reconciliation, and audit compliance.
  • Experience managing major incidents, 24/7 operations, and event readiness.
  • Experience with QHSE processes, vendor management, and SLA governance.
  • Entertainment, theme park, or real estate industry experience preferred.

jobs.title: Director - Asset Management - 50011443 - AG6
jobs.description:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture, bringing together world-class hospitality, leisure, entertainment, and mixed-use assets within one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious developments.

The role will provide owner-side oversight of asset condition, engineering performance, lifecycle planning, maintenance strategies, capital investment, operational readiness, and technical risk. Working closely with internal teams, operators, consultants, and service providers, the Director will ensure assets are safe, compliant, reliable, efficient, and maintained to world-class standards.

This is an opportunity to shape the long-term performance of complex destination assets and protect their operational reliability, guest experience, sustainability, and long-term value.

Application will close on the 28th of Sept.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop technical asset strategies, lifecycle plans, and capital investment priorities.
  • Lead asset condition assessments, technical due diligence, and engineering audits.
  • Oversee asset reliability, maintenance performance, statutory compliance, and technical risk.
  • Review and challenge operator and facilities management technical plans, budgets, and performance.
  • Support design reviews, testing, commissioning, operational readiness, and asset handover.
  • Manage defects, warranties, asset information, and technical documentation.

  • Experience in lifecycle planning, maintenance strategy, capex development, commissioning, handover, and defect management.
  • Strong understanding of MEP systems, fire and life safety, HSE, sustainability, and statutory compliance.
  • Experience within hospitality, mixed-use, entertainment, leisure, real estate, or large-scale destination assets is preferred.

jobs.title: Director - Asset Management - Technical Operations - 50010509 AG6
jobs.description:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360km² giga-project just outside Riyadh. From F1-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums, healthcare facilities, and world-class performance venues, Qiddiya is creating a destination unlike any other.

As the development evolves from large-scale construction into long-term operations and asset stewardship, the focus is shifting toward operational excellence, tenant partnerships, commercial performance, and sustainable asset management. This transition marks the next phase of Qiddiya’s journey — ensuring that its destinations and facilities are not only built to world-class standards, but operated, maintained, and optimized for generations to come.

This is more than a project — it is a national transformation. We are seeking ambitious professionals who want to play a critical role in shaping the operational future of one of the world’s most iconic developments. If you are driven by scale, impact, and the opportunity to help establish enduring, high-performing assets and experiences, Qiddiya is calling.

Job Summary:

The Technical Director is responsible for owner-side leadership and oversight of all technical aspects across hospitality assets, including hotel handovers, defects management, engineering governance, PPM strategy review, POMEC planning, technical audits, building systems performance, lifecycle planning, sustainability initiatives, and operational technical support.

The role provides strategic technical oversight throughout the asset lifecycle, ensuring assets are commissioned correctly, maintained effectively, and operated efficiently. The Technical Director will review operator engineering practices, maintenance programs, capital plans, technical standards, energy performance, and asset condition to ensure alignment with owner expectations and industry best practices.

The ideal candidate combines extensive hotel engineering leadership experience with asset management discipline, technical due diligence expertise, operational readiness knowledge, and strong stakeholder management capabilities.

Requirements

Hotel Handovers & Operational Readiness

  • Lead owner-side review and oversight of hospitality asset handovers from Development and Project Delivery teams into Operations.
  • Ensure all building systems, life safety systems, MEP infrastructure, specialist systems, and back-of-house facilities are fully commissioned, tested, documented, and ready for operations.
  • Review testing and commissioning reports, integrated systems testing, performance verification, and operator acceptance documentation.
  • Oversee defects identification, snag management, warranty tracking, and close-out processes.
  • Coordinate operational readiness reviews related to engineering, facilities management, technical services, maintenance workshops, spare parts, and asset documentation.
  • Ensure complete technical handover packages including O&M manuals, as-built drawings, asset registers, warranties, maintenance schedules, and digital asset information.

Technical Operations Oversight

  • Provide owner-side technical leadership across operating hotels and hospitality assets.
  • Monitor engineering performance, asset reliability, equipment uptime, and operational risks.
  • Review operator engineering reports, technical KPI performance, maintenance compliance, and critical asset condition assessments.
  • Support operators in resolving complex technical issues affecting operations, guest experience, safety, compliance, or asset performance.
  • Ensure technical operations align with owner objectives, operator obligations, and approved asset management plans.
  • Conduct periodic technical inspections and physical asset reviews.

 

PPM Strategy & Maintenance Governance

  • Review and challenge operator Preventive Planned Maintenance (PPM) strategies to ensure alignment with manufacturer requirements, operational realities, lifecycle expectations, and asset preservation objectives.
  • Evaluate maintenance frequencies, procedures, staffing levels, contract scopes, and resource allocation.
  • Monitor PPM compliance performance across all hospitality assets.
  • Review maintenance backlog levels and corrective maintenance trends.
  • Ensure critical assets receive appropriate preventive, predictive, and condition-based maintenance.
  • Establish technical governance frameworks and maintenance performance reporting structures.

 

POMEC Review & Capital Planning

  • Lead owner-side review of annual POMEC submissions and capital expenditure requests.
  • Assess requests against asset condition, lifecycle requirements, risk mitigation needs, statutory obligations, operational priorities, and return on investment.
  • Validate replacement cycles for major building systems, MEP equipment, FF&E, and engineering infrastructure.
  • Develop long-term capital planning frameworks and rolling asset replacement programs.
  • Ensure POMEC investments support asset preservation and long-term value creation.
  • Monitor approved capital expenditure implementation and project close-out.

 

Engineering & Building Systems Governance

  • Establish technical standards and engineering governance frameworks across the hospitality portfolio.
  • Review performance of HVAC, electrical, plumbing, fire and life safety, BMS, ELV, vertical transportation, water treatment, and specialist hospitality systems.
  • Ensure critical systems operate safely, efficiently, and in accordance with applicable regulations and standards.
  • Review technical risks associated with aging infrastructure, deferred maintenance, operational changes, and capital interventions.
  • Support development of technical policies, engineering standards, and asset management procedures.

 

Sustainability & Resource Management

  • Support implementation of sustainability initiatives across the portfolio.
  • Review building performance data relating to energy, water, waste, and carbon reduction opportunities.
  • Identify technical initiatives that improve operational efficiency and environmental performance.
  • Support compliance with sustainability frameworks including LEED, BREEAM, Green Key, GRESB, and relevant Saudi sustainability requirements.
  • Promote energy management, utility optimization, and lifecycle efficiency practices.

 

Technical Due Diligence & Asset Protection

  • Conduct technical due diligence assessments on operating and newly delivered assets.
  • Review asset condition surveys, engineering audits, lifecycle assessments, and risk analyses.
  • Identify technical risks and recommend mitigation plans.
  • Ensure asset management decisions are supported by technical data and lifecycle considerations.
  • Advise Asset Management leadership on technical implications of investment, operational, and capital expenditure decisions.

 

Stakeholder Management & Governance

  • Act as the primary owner-side technical representative with hotel operators, FM providers, consultants, contractors, project teams, and internal stakeholders.
  • Support technical reviews with operators and engineering leadership teams.
  • Present technical recommendations and risk assessments to senior management.
  • Ensure technical recommendations are supported by engineering rationale, financial analysis, asset preservation requirements, and operational impact assessments.
  • Coordinate closely with Asset Management, Development, Operational Readiness, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and Sustainability teams.

Qualifications & Experience

  • Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Facilities Management, or related discipline.
  • Professional Engineering registration or equivalent certification preferred.
  • Minimum 15 years of professional experience.
  • Minimum 10 years within hospitality engineering, hotel technical services, facilities management, or asset management.
  • Experience overseeing luxury hotels, resorts, mixed-use developments, or large integrated destinations.
  • Demonstrated experience leading hotel handovers, commissioning reviews, operational readiness, and defect management.
  • Proven experience reviewing PPM programs, maintenance strategies, and engineering governance frameworks.
  • Strong understanding of POMEC planning, lifecycle asset management, and technical capital expenditure evaluation.
  • Experience working with international hotel operators and hospitality brands.
  • GCC and large-scale destination development experience strongly preferred.

Preferred Skills

  • Strong technical understanding of hotel building systems and engineering operations.
  • Expertise in lifecycle asset management and capital planning.
  • Advanced knowledge of maintenance management methodologies.
  • Ability to challenge operators and consultants constructively while maintaining collaborative relationships.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability.
  • Experience interpreting technical drawings, commissioning documentation, and engineering reports.
  • Financial understanding of POMEC, CAPEX, lifecycle costing, and ROI assessments.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and presentation skills.
  • Strong governance, risk management, and compliance mindset.
  • Ability to translate technical issues into commercial and operational implications.

KPIs / Success Measures

  • Successful handover of hospitality assets with minimal operational defects or technical disruptions.
  • Completion of technical readiness reviews prior to hotel openings.
  • PPM compliance maintained above established portfolio targets.
  • Reduction in critical equipment failures and asset downtime across the portfolio.
  • POMEC submissions reviewed and approved within established timelines.
  • Capital projects delivered in accordance with approved scope, budget, and technical requirements.
  • Technical audit findings resolved within agreed corrective action periods.
  • Asset lifecycle plans developed and maintained for all operating assets.
  • Improvement in utility efficiency and sustainability performance metrics.
  • Reduction in maintenance backlog and deferred maintenance exposure.
  • Effective management of warranty claims, defects, and technical risk mitigation programs.

Benefits

  • Career development opportunities within a rapidly growing hospitality investment platform
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment
  • Exposure to high-profile hotel and mixed-use developments in Saudi Arabia
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus

jobs.title: Director - City OPS IT/OT Network and Security Operations (DEL3)
jobs.description:
The Director of IT/OT Network & Security Operations is a critical leadership role within City Operations IT, responsible for the end-to-end management, reliability, and security of Qiddiya’s converged IT and Operational Technology (OT) infrastructure.

As Qiddiya transitions from construction to operations, this role will lead operational readiness, infrastructure acceptance, and the ongoing management of city-wide digital platforms, including fiber networks, active network equipment, smart city systems, and physical security networks (VMS, ACS, CCTV).

The role serves as a key bridge between enterprise IT and industrial OT environments, ensuring seamless integration, high availability, and a robust cybersecurity posture across all city operations. It requires deep technical expertise in network architecture and security, alongside strong vendor management and cross-functional leadership to collaborate effectively with QTECH, MDU, District Master Developers, and third-party operators.

Key Responsibilities

1. Operational Leadership & Strategy

  • Lead the IT/OT Network and Security Operations function for Qiddiya City IT Operations.
  • Define and execute the operational strategy for converged IT/OT environments, aligned with the City Operations Target Operating Model (TOM) and Qiddiya’s digital vision.
  • Establish and manage interfaces with the Network Operations Center (NOC) and Security Operations Center (SOC) for city-level infrastructure.
  • Define, monitor, and enforce SLAs, KPIs, and performance metrics across internal teams and external service providers.

2. Infrastructure & Network Operations

  • Oversee day-to-day operations, maintenance, and optimization of city-wide network infrastructure, including fiber backbone, MMRs, MDCs, and active network components.
  • Manage the operational lifecycle of OT networks supporting smart city use cases across utilities, transportation, and facility management.
  • Ensure high availability, resilience, and redundancy of critical network topologies supporting city operations.
  • Lead incident management, root cause analysis, and resolution of complex IT/OT network issues.

3. Security Operations & Governance

  • Oversee operational security systems and their supporting network infrastructure.
  • Implement and monitor cybersecurity controls across OT environments, including network segregation, access control, and threat detection, aligned with QTECH cybersecurity standards.
  • Coordinate vulnerability assessments, penetration testing, and security audits for city infrastructure.
  • Ensure compliance with national cybersecurity regulations (e.g., NCA) and internal Qiddiya policies.

4. Transition, Handover & Acceptance

  • Act as the primary City Operations IT authority for the acceptance and handover of network and security infrastructure from QTECH, MDU, and District Master Developers.
  • Define operational readiness criteria, testing protocols, and documentation standards for onboarding new assets.
  • Participate in design reviews to ensure operational, maintainability, and security requirements are embedded early in the lifecycle.

5. Vendor & Stakeholder Management

  • Manage relationships and operational contracts with neutral hosts, data center operators, and managed service providers.
  • Collaborate closely with QTECH Design teams to ensure alignment on architecture, shared services, and governance frameworks.
  • Engage with Business Units (e.g., Transport, Utilities, Security) to ensure IT/OT infrastructure meets operational and use-case requirements.

Requirements

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Telecommunications, Cybersecurity, or a related engineering discipline.

Experience

  • 12–15 years of progressive experience in network engineering, IT/OT operations, and cybersecurity, including at least 5 years in a senior leadership role.
  • Proven track record in managing large-scale, mission-critical infrastructure within complex environments such as smart cities, giga-projects, utilities, or industrial sectors.
  • Extensive experience bridging IT and OT environments, with a strong understanding of industrial control systems (ICS), SCADA, and IoT network architectures.
  • Demonstrated experience in transitioning infrastructure from construction and delivery phases into stable, live operations.

Technical Skills & Certifications

  • Deep expertise in network routing, switching, and topology design (e.g., Cisco, Juniper, or equivalent technologies).
  • Strong knowledge of OT cybersecurity standards and frameworks (e.g., IEC 62443, NIST).
  • Experience with physical security network infrastructure, including CCTV, VMS, and ACS systems.
  • Relevant industry certifications are highly desirable, such as:
    • Networking: CCIE, JNCIE, or equivalent.
    • Security: CISSP, CISM, GICSP, or equivalent.
    • Service Management: ITIL v4.

Core Competencies

  • Strategic thinker with strong problem-solving and decision-making capabilities.
  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to influence cross-functional teams and executive leadership.
  • Ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-paced, and evolving environments.
  • Strong vendor management and contract negotiation expertise.

jobs.title: Director - City Technology Governance & PMO
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and strategic Director for City Technology Governance & PMO to lead and enhance the technology governance framework across the Qiddiya city development. The successful candidate will oversee the Project Management Office (PMO) related to technology initiatives, ensuring alignment with the company’s overall vision and strategic goals. This leadership role involves driving best practices in technology governance, risk management, and compliance while facilitating cross-functional collaboration among multiple stakeholders.

The Director will be responsible for establishing and strengthening IT governance policies, standards, and procedures; driving technology project delivery excellence; and managing the portfolio of technology projects with an emphasis on quality, timelines, and budgets. Operating at the intersection of technology and city planning, this role demands a visionary leader who can effectively manage complex technology programs and influence decision-making at senior levels to support the successful deployment of innovative technology solutions in line with Qiddiya’s unique vision.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, implement, and maintain robust technology governance frameworks tailored to city-scale smart infrastructure and digital services.

jobs.title: Director - Compliance & Certification - 50011271 AA9
jobs.description:

Quality Compliance Framework and Requirements Tracking

Compliance Evidence Review and Implementation Monitoring

  • Manage compliance evidence review activities by assessing project records, compliance evidence, quality documentation, audit outputs and stakeholder inputs to determine whether required controls, approvals, inspections and implementation evidence demonstrate alignment with applicable quality requirements.
  • Monitor compliance action status, unresolved evidence gaps, recurring issues and delayed responses to identify follow-up needs, corrective action requirements and potential escalation points.
  • Ensure compliance evidence reviews provide traceable confirmation of implementation status to enable timely action on quality compliance risks and unresolved requirements.

Certification Readiness and International Organization for Standardization Alignment

  • Manage certification readiness activities by reviewing QMS documentation, process implementation evidence, audit results and corrective action status to assess readiness against International Organization for Standardization (ISO) or equivalent certification requirements.
  • Consolidate certification readiness inputs, gap assessments, evidence records, action plans and stakeholder updates to maintain visibility of progress toward future certification objectives.
  • Follow-up with business units, process owners and relevant Quality Management teams to close certification-related evidence gaps, process weaknesses and corrective action requirements.
  • Ensure certification readiness activities identify remaining gaps, improve the completeness of supporting evidence and prepare Development teams to meet future external certification or surveillance requirements.

Compliance Reporting, Records and Improvement Actions

  • Consolidate compliance findings, certification readiness status, action trackers, evidence gaps and recurring themes to facilitate quality reporting, dashboard inputs and management visibility.
  • Review compliance trends, certification gaps, stakeholder feedback and recurring non-compliance areas to identify improvement opportunities, training needs and process clarification requirements.

Strategy and Planning

Policies, Processes, and Procedures

Stakeholder Management

Manage the implementation of a comprehensive stakeholder engagement strategy for the Compliance & Certification department, identify all key stakeholders relevant to the department, develop clear communication channels to facilitate engagement with stakeholders, track the effectiveness of the stakeholder engagement strategy, and recommend adjustments as needed.

Budget

Manage the operations of the Compliance & Certification department’s budgeting process within the approved budget, analyze the financial data to pinpoint variances between actual performance and the budget, support budget forecasts and cost-control actions, and ensure compliance with all financial reporting regulations and internal policies.

Change Management

Ensure continuous improvement of Compliance & Certification department systems, processes, and practices by analyzing existing business systems and processes to identify inefficiencies or opportunities for improvement and implement solutions to address identified gaps.

People Management

Translate strategic direction into actionable plans for the Compliance & Certification department, collaborate with stakeholders to develop SMART goals that align from the unit level to individual teams and staff, and manage the overall talent management cycle at the department.

Reports

Manage the development of a comprehensive reporting process for the Compliance & Certification department, guide the staff on the reporting process, and ensure they understand Qiddiya's reporting requirements.

Additional Duties

This job description outlines the duties that are typically performed by the jobholder; these duties are not the only responsibilities required by the role, and management may assign additional tasks as necessary.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications

  • Preferred: Master’s degree inEngineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, Project Management, or a related field.
  • Required: Bachelor’s degree inEngineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, Project Management, or a related field.

Professional Certifications

  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Quality Management, Project Management, or a related field
  • Professional certifications or memberships with recognizedquality, audit, compliance, certification, construction, engineering or project management institutes (e.g., ISO 9001 Lead Auditor / Lead Implementer, CQI/IRCA, ASQ, PMI, RICS, SCE) are preferred.

Years of Experience

A minimum of 14 years of experience in quality compliance, quality management, certification readiness, quality assurance, audit, construction quality, engineering, construction management, or related fields is required, including relevant years in a managerial role.

Skills

Provide strong governance to ensure SiD inputs are fully integrated, documented, and actioned in alignment with organizational safety expectations and regulatory obligations.

9.     Coordination: When undertaking technical reviews of the design provided by the design consultant team, ensure documents are fully coordinated across disciplines with scope clearly identified and defined, while aligning with project brief and performance specifications unique to healthcare facilities.

10.  Stakeholder management: Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure expectations are clearly communicated, requirements are incorporated into the design, timely direction is provided, and all necessary approvals are secured.

11.  Compliance: Ensure all activities are executed in accordance with QIC policies, processes, systems, and reporting requirements, maintaining the highest standards of organizational compliance.

  • Monitor governance compliance, reporting requirements, and development assurance activities to enable transparent decision-making, governance oversight, and timely escalation of development risks and issues. 

 

Integrated Development Coordination 

  • Manage coordination among planning, design, commercial, delivery, and operational workstreams for assigned developments to achieve integrated execution and effective management of development activities.  
  • Ensure effective collaboration among business units, central functions, consultants, contractors, operators, and delivery stakeholders to maintain alignment with development priorities and delivery requirements. 
  • Monitor development interdependencies, stakeholder interfaces, and sequencing requirements for assigned developments to enable integrated delivery, operational readiness, and effective execution. 

 

Partner and Operational Integration 

  • Manage engagement with tenants, operators, partners, brands, service providers, and internal stakeholders to achieve operational integration, tenant readiness, and activation readiness across assigned developments. 
  • Contribute development input to operational readiness, activation planning, and integration activities to maintain asset functionality, delivery alignment, and long-term operational requirements. 
  • Ensure operator, partner, brand, and service provider requirements are incorporated into development planning, design, and delivery activities to achieve asset functionality, activation readiness, and operational success. 

 

Development Performance and Risk Management 

  • Monitor development performance, delivery progress, and execution outcomes across assigned developments to promote achievement of approved development objectives, operational readiness, and delivery performance requirements. 
  • Manage development risks, mitigation actions, issue resolution activities, and recovery measures for assigned developments to minimize disruption and maintain delivery outcomes.
  • Consolidate development reporting, performance monitoring information, and governance tracking activities for assigned developments to enable informed decision-making, performance oversight, and timely management intervention. 

  • Specific Responsibilities :

    • Develop retail planning approaches, commercial positioning recommendations, tenant mix recommendations, and development inputs for Resort Core developments to achieve approved retail strategies, customer experience objectives, and long-term commercial performance.

    • Present retail planning and commercial recommendations during development brief, master planning, and precinct planning activities to influence retail outcomes, customer experience objectives, and commercial viability. 
    • Ensure tenant mix recommendations, retail categories, and commercial positioning approaches contribute to a complementary retail ecosystem, destination objectives, customer experience expectations, and sustainable commercial performance.

Market Activation and Leasing Readiness

  • Manage coordination with leasing, tenancy delivery, asset management, host development teams, and development stakeholders to enable successful activation and operational readiness of retail developments.

Requirements

  • Preferred: Master’s degree in Real Estate Development, Property Development, Retail Development, Urban Development, Business Administration (MBA), or a related field. 
  • Required: Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate Development, Property Development, Urban Planning, Architecture, Construction Management, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field. 
  • Professional certifications or memberships with recognized real estate, retail, development, construction, or project management institutes (e.g., RICS, ULI, PMI, CIOB, ICSC) are preferred. 
    • Demonstrates fluency in written and verbal English, with proficiency in Arabic preferred. 
    • Analyzes operational data and information to support decision-making, identify issues, and contribute to improving processes and outcomes. 
    • Coordinates with internal stakeholders to support the effective execution of activities and ensure alignment across teams. 
    • Manages team activities and ensures accuracy, attention to detail, and quality in deliverables and operational outputs. 
    • Capable of managing retail development activities across Resort Core developments, including retail planning, commercial positioning, tenant mix integration, and customer experience considerations within mixed-use and destination development environments.  
    • In-depth knowledge of aligning retail development requirements with commercial objectives, market demand considerations, customer experience expectations, and long-term retail asset performance across integrated destination developments.  
    • Expertise in coordinating complex stakeholder environments and collaborating with host development teams, leasing and tenancy delivery functions, consultants, operators, commercial teams, and development partners. 
    • A minimum of 14 years of experience in retail development, mixed-use development, commercial real estate development, destination development, or integrated development environments, with relevant exposure in development management or development coordination roles, including relevant years in a managerial role. 
    • Demonstrated experience leading retail development initiatives, including retail planning, commercial positioning, tenant mix development, development integration, and leasing readiness across complex mixed-use, hospitality, entertainment, or destination development environments.

jobs.title: Director - Development - Hospitality - 20013066 HS8
jobs.description:
About the role 

At Qiddiya Investment Company, we are shaping a landmark destination redefining entertainment, culture and hospitality in the Kingdom. The Hospitality Business Unit is developing a portfolio of hotel assets central to this vision. As these assets progress, we are seeking experienced professionals to help deliver them to the highest standards of design quality, guest experience and commercial performance. 

In this role, you will lead the end-to-end development of hospitality assets, from concept and business case through to delivery. You will shape development strategy, guide critical decisions and ensure assets deliver distinctive guest experiences, strong commercial performance and long-term value for both the asset and across the wider destination. Working across key stakeholders and interfaces, you will drive alignment, manage complexity and ensure assets are commercially robust and in line with Qiddiya’s vision and development objectives. 

Key Responsibilities 

  • Lead the strategic development of hospitality assets from early-stage briefing through to delivery, handover and operational readiness 
  • Shape asset strategy, feasibility and business plans to define positioning, guest experience and value creation 
  • Drive cross-functional alignment across strategy, asset management, design, delivery and Operators to ensure seamless progression from development through to operations  
  • Ensure assets align with Qiddiya’s vision and quality benchmarks, delivering best-in-class design and guest experience 
  • Provide strategic oversight of key asset decisions, including positioning, room mix, amenities, guest experience and operational planning to maximise differentiation and portfolio performance 
  • Lead key asset validation milestones, including mock-up rooms reviews and critical gateway decisions, balancing Operator, design, commercial and delivery requirements 
  • Proactively manage interfaces, risks and opportunities across all development workstreams to protect value and maintain delivery momentum 
  • Lead governance and executive reporting processes, clearly articulating asset strategy, development priorities, risks and recommendations in key forums 
  • Mentor, guide and develop teams, embedding strong development capability and best-practice approaches across the portfolio 

Requirements

Skills & Attributes Required 

  • Experience shaping development strategy, feasibility and positioning 
  • Strong commercial acumen and understanding of value creation 
  • Strong judgement in complex, high-value development environments 
  • Ability to manage complexity across stakeholders, workstreams and project stages 
  • Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive key decisions through clear communication and storytelling 
  • Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments, managing ambiguity and shifting priorities 
  • Proficiency in project management and reporting tools (e.g. Aconex etc.) 

Preferred Background & Experience 

  • Proven track record delivering complex assets (e.g. luxury hospitality, mixed-use)  
  • Experience developing hospitality assets with Operator engagement (selection, onboarding or alignment) 
  • Experience across full development lifecycle from feasibility through delivery and handover 
  • Experience working within multi-stakeholder, large-scale destination or master planned environments 
  • GCC experience preferred 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Real Estate Development, Architecture, Engineering or related discipline 

Professional Certifications

  • Professional membership or recognised certification preferred (e.g. RICS, RIBA, PMP or equivalent)  

Years of Experience 

  • 15+ years’ experience in real estate or hospitality development

jobs.title: Director - Digital Engineering
jobs.description:
The Director – Digital Engineering will provide technical leadership across Qiddiya’s core digital product streams, ensuring that all platforms, services, and digital capabilities are designed and delivered to the highest engineering standards. The role is accountable for ensuring that digital products are built with a reusable, scalable, resilient, reliable, observable, and extensible architecture that can be leveraged across multiple Qiddiya assets. This includes setting the technical direction, challenging low-level engineering decisions, governing solution quality, and ensuring that all delivery outcomes meet the standards defined by Qiddiya Investment Company. The Director – Digital Engineering will work in a multi-vendor delivery environment and will play a critical role in ensuring that vendors, engineering teams, and embedded technical leaders are aligned to Qiddiya’s technology strategy, architecture principles, and operating model.


Key Responsibilities:

Technical Leadership & Engineering Governance

• Lead the technical oversight of Qiddiya’s core digital product streams, ensuring that all solutions are designed and delivered in line with Qiddiya’s target architecture, engineering standards, and long-term technology vision.

• Define and enforce engineering principles around reusability, scalability, resiliency, reliability, observability, maintainability, security, and performance across all digital products and platforms.

• Ensure that all technical decisions are properly reviewed, challenged, and validated by Qiddiya, with clear ownership and governance over architecture and engineering direction.

• Act as a senior technical authority capable of engaging at low-level design, architecture, code, integration, infrastructure, and operational decision-making levels.

• Challenge vendor proposals, solution designs, implementation approaches, and technical trade offs to ensure that Qiddiya retains control over critical engineering decisions.

Product Architecture & Reusability

• Ensure that digital products are built as reusable capabilities that can be extended and adopted across multiple Qiddiya assets, rather than being designed as isolated one-off implementations.

• Drive the creation of reusable patterns, components, services, APIs, integration approaches, and engineering guidelines that support product scalability across the Qiddiya ecosystem.

• Partner closely with architecture, product, delivery, DevSecOps, cloud, and security teams to ensure that product delivery aligns with the overall digital target state.

Leadership of Staff Engineers
• Lead and manage Staff Software Engineers who will be embedded within product streams and work closely with vendor teams.

• Set clear expectations for Staff Engineers around technical governance, architecture review, engineering excellence, code quality, observability, resiliency, and vendor challenge.

• Ensure that Staff Engineers are actively influencing product delivery, reviewing technical decisions, and protecting Qiddiya’s long-term technology interests.

• Build a strong internal engineering capability that reduces dependency on vendors for critical technical decisions and strengthens Qiddiya’s ownership of its digital platforms.

Requirements

• Significant experience in senior engineering leadership roles, ideally within large-scale digital platforms, e-commerce, entertainment, travel, hospitality, fintech, or other high-traffic consumer digital environments.

• Strong hands-on technical background with the ability to challenge detailed engineering, architecture, integration, infrastructure, and implementation decisions.

• Proven experience leading engineering teams in a complex multi-vendor or system integrator delivery model.

• Strong experience governing the delivery of reusable digital platforms, shared services, APIs, and scalable product architectures.

• Strong understanding of modern software engineering practices, DevSecOps, cloud-native architecture, observability, resiliency, reliability engineering, and secure-by-design delivery.

• Experience working with executive stakeholders and translating technical risks, trade-offs, and recommendations into clear business and delivery decisions.
