jobs.title: Director - Irrigation
jobs.description:
The Director – Irrigation is responsible for leading the irrigation planning, design strategy, standards, and technical assurance framework for Qiddiya’s landscape and public realm portfolio. The role ensures irrigation requirements are embedded from master planning through design development, procurement support, Stage Gate review, and handover readiness, in alignment with Qiddiya’s City Framework Plan, sustainability commitments, water stewardship objectives, horticultural performance requirements, smart city integration, and long-term asset outcomes.

 

Key Responsibilities

Strategic Planning & Policy

·       Lead the strategic direction for irrigation planning and design across Qiddiya’s landscape and public realm portfolio, ensuring alignment with master development objectives, district strategies, water availability, sustainability requirements, and future operational needs.

·       Own and maintain Qiddiya-wide irrigation policies, standards, planning frameworks, design criteria, water budgets, hydro-zoning principles, technical guidelines, and compliance processes.

·       Provide strategic direction on irrigation demand planning, TSE use, water quality, salinity risk, leaching requirements, drainage interfaces, water allocation, resilience assumptions, and smart irrigation strategy.

·       Translate water conservation, sustainability, public realm, and horticultural objectives into clear design requirements, decision frameworks, assurance checkpoints, and performance expectations.

·       Monitor applicable regulations, authority requirements, regional practices, international best practice, emerging technologies, and innovation opportunities relevant to irrigation planning and landscape water management.

 

Design Governance, Standards & Technical Authority

·       Lead the development, review, governance, and continuous improvement of irrigation design guidelines, specifications, calculation methodologies, assurance processes, and technical review protocols.

·       Act as the technical authority for irrigation design submissions, including masterplans, design reports, calculations, drawings, schedules, specifications, and technical studies.

·       Ensure submissions are assessed against approved standards, water demand targets, operability requirements, risk controls, and Qiddiya design expectations.

·       Establish approval, assurance, and escalation processes for design decisions, departures, non-compliances, technical risks, and cross-disciplinary interfaces.

·       Provide strategic guidance on irrigation technologies, central control systems, filtration, fertigation, dosing, metering, sensors, digital asset data, BIM/GIS coordination, and smart irrigation integration.

·       Ensure irrigation design is integrated with planting, soils, landscape character, water availability, utility infrastructure, district phasing, access, maintainability, commissioning requirements, and long-term asset performance.

 

Portfolio Planning, Design Integration & Commercial Support

·       Provide senior oversight of the irrigation planning and design portfolio to ensure projects align with approved strategies, standards, budgets, programmes, quality expectations, sustainability objectives, and future operational requirements.

·       Lead irrigation input into procurement strategies, scopes of work, consultant briefs, tender documentation, technical evaluation criteria, design deliverables, cost plans, and programme requirements.

·       Direct consultants and specialist advisors responsible for irrigation master planning, design, modelling, standards, technical studies, specifications, calculations, and assurance outputs.

·       Review design performance, identify planning and design risks, resolve technical issues, and escalate matters requiring leadership direction with clear recommendations.

·       Ensure irrigation requirements are embedded in masterplan reviews, Stage Gate submissions, design reviews, implementation planning, cost planning, risk management, quality assurance, commissioning strategies, handover requirements, and asset information requirements.

·       Lead design audits, technical reviews, lessons-learned reviews, and value engineering to improve technical quality, water efficiency, maintainability, resilience, lifecycle value, and operational readiness.

 

Water Demand, Digital Integration & Design Performance

·       Establish design performance metrics, water demand benchmarks, hydro-zoning checks, efficiency targets, and assurance dashboards for consultant submissions and district-level planning decisions.

·       Oversee irrigation demand forecasts, TSE demand assumptions, peak flow estimates, storage and distribution interfaces, pressure zoning assumptions, and design-stage water balance inputs.

·       Champion digital design integration, including BIM/GIS coordination, central control narratives, sensor and metering strategies, asset data requirements, smart city interfaces, and future operational data needs.

·       Ensure planning decisions are supported by clear data, assumptions, calculations, risk assessments, and evidence-based recommendations.

 

Stakeholder Leadership & Cross-Functional Integration

·       Represent Public Realm and Master Development as the senior irrigation planning and design lead in strategic discussions, governance forums, design reviews, technical workshops, consultant engagements, authority interfaces, and cross-functional coordination meetings.

·       Align landscape architecture, horticulture, infrastructure, wet utilities, sustainability, smart city, cost planning, delivery, operations, procurement, asset management, and district teams on integrated irrigation design outcomes.

·       Lead stakeholder discussions on irrigation strategy, water demand, design standards, resilience assumptions, operational requirements, sustainability, constructability, maintainability, and technical compliance.

·       Prepare and present technical narratives, executive briefings, recommendations, risk summaries, decision papers, design assurance updates, cost implications, programme considerations, and management updates.

·       Engage consultants, contractors, suppliers, authorities, and strategic partners to ensure irrigation planning and design solutions are coordinated, compliant, innovative, efficient, and aligned with Qiddiya’s long-term objectives.

 

Leadership, Capability Building & Team Management

·       Lead, develop, and manage irrigation planning and design team members and specialist resources, setting clear priorities, accountabilities, and performance expectations.

·       Build internal irrigation capability through guidance, templates, review processes, knowledge sharing, lessons learned, and technical standards.

·       Promote collaboration, accountability, innovation, technical excellence, safety, quality, sustainability, and continuous improvement across the irrigation function.

·       Support workforce planning by identifying skills gaps, future resource requirements, consultant support needs, and specialist technical expertise.

·       Provide senior coaching and technical direction to internal teams, consultants, and delivery partners on irrigation planning, design assurance, water efficiency, maintainability, and operational readiness requirements.

 

Requirements

·       Bachelor’s degree in Irrigation Engineering, Water Resources Management, Agricultural Engineering, Environmental Science, or a related discipline; a relevant postgraduate qualification is desirable.

·       Professional certification in irrigation design, water management, sustainability, project management, digital design, or a related discipline is preferred.

·       Minimum 15 years’ relevant experience, including senior leadership experience in irrigation planning, design governance, water management, landscape infrastructure, public realm design, or major mixed-use development.

·       Proven experience leading irrigation strategy, standards, technical assurance, consultant management, Stage Gate reviews, and multidisciplinary coordination on large-scale city, district, public realm, landscape, infrastructure, municipal, parks, or giga-project programmes.

·       Strong understanding of arid-region landscape irrigation, TSE irrigation, water quality, salinity management, soil-water-plant relationships, hydro-zoning, irrigation demand calculations, smart control systems, design performance metrics, and lifecycle asset considerations.

·       Demonstrated ability to lead complex design portfolios, manage senior stakeholders, oversee consultants and specialist advisors, govern technical deliverables, review budgets and programmes, and support executive-level decision-making.

·       Knowledge of KSA regulations, authority requirements, environmental standards, sustainability frameworks, water usage controls, recycled water requirements, landscape infrastructure standards, and planning/design compliance processes is preferred.

 

Key Skills & Competencies

·       Strategic leadership and ability to set direction, govern standards, make decisions, resolve ambiguity, and influence outcomes across complex planning and design environments.

·       Advanced technical expertise in irrigation planning, design, demand calculations, design assurance, water efficiency, smart irrigation, resilience, constructability, maintainability, commissioning requirements, and operational readiness.

·       Strong planning, commercial, governance, procurement, risk management, and assurance capability, with the ability to translate technical requirements into scopes, deliverables, cost plans, programmes, and decision papers.

·       Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with the ability to engage senior leaders, technical teams, consultants, contractors, authorities, utilities, operators, and external partners.

·       Ability to build teams, mentor specialists, develop capability, manage performance, and promote collaboration across organisational boundaries.

·       Strong analytical, problem-solving, and systems-thinking capability, with the ability to identify strategic design risks, challenge assumptions, assess trade-offs, and recommend practical solutions.

·       Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and familiarity with irrigation design, modelling, calculation, BIM/GIS coordination, smart control, asset data, digital design, or CAD-based tools relevant to large-scale development environments.

jobs.title: Director - Major Events Operations
jobs.description:
The Director, Major Events Operations is the second-in-charge to the Executive Director, Major Events and provides senior leadership across the planning, readiness and delivery of public realm event operations throughout Qiddiya City. The role translates the Major Events strategy into coordinated city-wide operating plans, ensuring that public spaces, city services, temporary event infrastructure and operational partners are integrated, safe, guest-focused and ready for delivery.

Acting on behalf of the Executive Director when delegated, the Director leads cross-functional coordination, drives decisions and escalations, and provides operational assurance from early planning through live event delivery, demobilisation and post-event review.

Deputy Leadership and Direction

Act as the principal deputy to the Executive Director, Major Events, providing continuity of leadership and representing the function in delegated forums, workshops and operational decision-making bodies.

Support the definition of the Major Events operating model, priorities, annual programme and resource plan, converting strategic direction into clear workstreams, accountabilities and delivery milestones.

Lead, coach and coordinate assigned Major Events team members and consultants, setting expectations, monitoring performance against agreed deliverables and resolving delivery constraints.

Prepare concise executive briefings, recommendations and decision papers on readiness, risks, dependencies, budget and operational performance.

Public Realm Event Operations Planning

Lead the development and integration of public realm event operations plans for city-wide and district-level activity, covering waste and cleansing, public realm readiness, temporary structures, wayfinding and signage, guest services, accessibility, security interfaces, emergency interfaces, welfare, logistics and event support services.

Establish event-specific concepts of operations, operating procedures, deployment plans, service schedules, resource assumptions, zone plans and escalation protocols appropriate to event scale and risk.

Ensure plans address the complete event lifecycle, including build-up, testing, event days, transition between sessions or events, breakdown, reinstatement and close-out.

Maintain clear scope boundaries between City Operations and asset or venue operators. Coordinate city-side interfaces and dependencies without assuming responsibility for the direct operation of venues or individual assets.

Integrated City Coordination and Governance

Coordinate planning across City Operations, districts, venues and assets, mobility, security, emergency services, technology and telecommunications, facilities management, public realm, utilities, guest experience, commercial, procurement and external stakeholders.

Establish and manage governance routines, integrated planning workshops, action trackers, decision logs, interface registers and reporting cycles that support timely closure of cross-functional issues.

Confirm ownership of interfaces and hand-offs between permanent city operations, temporary event overlays, venue operations and third-party delivery partners.

Escalate material decisions, unresolved dependencies and changes in scope to the Executive Director with clear options and recommended actions.

Readiness, Assurance and Risk Management

Develop and manage an integrated operational readiness framework, including readiness criteria, evidence requirements, assurance reviews, testing, rehearsals, simulations, inspections and go or no-go recommendations.

Own the consolidated Major Events operational risk, issue, dependency and opportunity process for assigned events, ensuring accountable owners, mitigations, due dates and escalation thresholds are defined.

Challenge plans for practicality, capacity, resilience, accessibility, guest impact, health and safety, security, environmental performance and continuity of essential city services.

Ensure lessons from exercises, previous events, benchmarking and post-event reviews are incorporated into revised plans and standards.

Live Event Delivery and Command

Provide senior operational leadership during event periods and, when delegated, lead the city-side event operations function within the agreed command, control and communication structure.

Coordinate public realm operational deployment, monitor service performance and city conditions, resolve cross-functional issues and maintain an accurate common operating picture for leadership.

Ensure incidents, service failures and emerging risks are logged, triaged, escalated and communicated through approved protocols.

Oversee orderly demobilisation and public realm reinstatement, confirming defects, outstanding actions, service recovery needs and hand-back requirements.

Commercial, Procurement and Partner Management

Define operational scopes, service requirements, performance standards and evaluation inputs for consultants, suppliers and event delivery partners supporting public realm operations.

Support procurement planning, tender evaluation, mobilisation and contract governance, working with Commercial and Procurement to protect programme, quality, value and accountability.

Monitor supplier readiness and delivery against contractual obligations, service levels and event requirements, escalating shortfalls and coordinating corrective action.

Validate operational budget assumptions, forecasts, change requests and cost pressures for assigned workstreams, providing recommendations to the Executive Director.

Continuous Improvement and Capability Building

Develop repeatable standards, templates, playbooks, checklists and reporting tools that strengthen Qiddiya City’s Major Events capability and support consistent delivery across the event portfolio.

Build strong working relationships with internal functions, government entities, emergency services, operators, promoters and delivery partners.

Support workforce and volunteer integration by defining operational roles, deployment requirements, briefing needs, supervision arrangements and welfare interfaces for public realm operations.

Lead structured post-event reviews, capture evidence-based lessons and convert agreed improvements into accountable actions for future events.

Requirements

Education

Bachelor’s degree in Event Management, Operations Management, Business, Engineering, Facilities Management, Hospitality or a related discipline.

Postgraduate qualification in a relevant field is desirable.

Relevant professional certification in project, programme, event, safety, risk or emergency management is advantageous.

Experience

Senior leadership experience in planning and delivering complex, high-profile events, festivals, sporting events, entertainment destinations or city-scale operations.

Demonstrated experience leading public realm or city-side event operations across multiple functions, suppliers and stakeholder organisations.

Proven experience acting as a deputy or senior operational lead, with authority to coordinate teams, make time-critical decisions and represent executive leadership when delegated.

Experience developing operational plans, readiness frameworks, command-and-control arrangements, testing and rehearsal programmes, and post-event improvement plans.

Strong commercial and supplier-management experience, including scope development, procurement support, mobilisation, performance management and budget oversight.

Experience in Saudi Arabia or the GCC, and familiarity with large-scale destination or giga-project environments, is desirable.

Preferred Background

Major event organising committees, destination or city operations, event promoters, venue or precinct operators, government event authorities, integrated facilities management, or specialist event operations consultancies.

Delivery exposure to both planned major events and live operational environments requiring multi-agency coordination and rapid issue resolution.

jobs.title: Director - Office Leasing (Commercial Office) SPA2 50013073

jobs.title: Director - Operations & Event Delivery
jobs.description:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega-project just outside Riyadh. From F1-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we’re creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it’s a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we’re hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you’re driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling

 

Role Purpose

Lead the planning and execution of all event operations and site-wide delivery at Cultural and Heritage program, ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality delivery of cultural programming, guest experience, and large-scale event operations in alignment with asset objectives

Key Responsibilities

Event Operations Planning & Delivery

  • Lead end-to-end planning and execution of all event operations across Cultural and Heritage program, including the Festival and year-round programming
  • Translate programming, marketing, and commercial plans into detailed operational delivery models
  • Develop and manage event operations plans, schedules, and resource requirements
  • Ensure seamless execution of all programming and activities in line with operational plans

 

 Logistics, Site Readiness & Overlay

Asset & Site Coordination

Asset Management & Group Alignment

  • Coordinate with Qiddiya Group functions and external authorities where required
  • Provide operational input into planning, budgeting, and performance reviews

 

Performance Monitoring & Continuous Improvement

Requirements

-          Proven experience in:

jobs.title: Director - Organization Learning
jobs.description:
About the Role:

We are seeking an experienced, forward-thinking Head of Learning to lead the development and delivery of Qiddiya’s learning architecture, ensuring learning enables performance today and builds the capabilities required for future growth.

 

Reporting to the Executive Director – Talent Management, the role will partner closely with business and HR leaders to align learning with operational priorities, close critical skill gaps, and embed continuous development. Combining strategic focus, strong knowledge of the Saudi learning environment, and hands-on execution, it will build internal capability, shape impactful learning experiences, and position Qiddiya at the forefront of learning and performance.

Requirements

Key Responsibilities:

Learning Architecture & Pathways

· Design and implement Qiddiya’s learning architecture, including frameworks, pathways, curricula, standards, and development journeys across priority capability areas.

·  Translate strategic priorities into practical learning roadmaps and interventions that support current performance and future workforce readiness.

·  Ensure learning pathways are relevant to Qiddiya’s functions, assets, and subsidiaries, and linked to measurable improvements in capability, performance, and business outcomes.

Learning Governance, Policy & Standards

·  Establish and continuously improve learning governance, policies, standards, operating procedures, and decision rights across Qiddiya.

·  Ensure learning practices align with Saudi regulatory requirements, internal policies, enterprise risk expectations, and quality standards.

·  Define reporting and effectiveness measures to track adoption, application, capability growth, stakeholder value, and return on learning investment.

Digital & In-Person Learning Ecosystem

·   Lead the growth, adoption, and integration of Qiddiya’s learning ecosystem, including SuccessFactors, Sana, and future digital learning solutions.

·   Create blended learning experiences that combines digital, in-person, social, experiential, and performance-based learning.

·    Partner with internal stakeholders, providers, academic institutions, and professional bodies to improve access, personalization, learner experience, and insight through technology and data.

Leadership of the Learning Organization

·  Design and lead the future learning organization, including learning business partnership, digital learning, operations, design, and enabling capabilities.

·   Build a resilient, service-oriented, commercially aware learning team that partners effectively with the business and delivers with pace and quality.

Key Requirements:

Experience:

·   Minimum of 15 years of experience in Learning & Development, with at least 8 years in a leadership or managerial role

·   Proven success designing and delivering enterprise learning in complex, fast-paced environments, ideally with regional or global scope including the Middle East

·   Strong understanding of the Saudi learning environment, including relevant regulatory, governance, workforce development, and compliance expectations.

·   Strong experience managing internal stakeholders, external providers, budgets, business cases, and learning investment decisions.

·   Digitally fluent, with a strong understanding of learning technologies, experience working with SuccessFactors and Sana preferred

·  Experience building internal capability and managing external partnerships

·  Demonstrated use of learning analytics and data to improve outcomes and show impact

 

Educational Qualifications:

·   Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Education, Psychology, Business Administration or related field.

·   Master’s degree (e.g. Organization Psychology, Organization Behavior) or relevant advanced HR certifications (e.g. CIPD, ATD, SHRM) preferred.

 

Skills & Competencies:

·       Deep understanding of learning science, adult development principles, and performance-based learning approaches

·       Strategic thinker with commercial acumen and a clear link between learning and business goals

·       Proven ability to communicate, engage and influence all levels of the organization including senior leaders, driving buy-in and fostering a culture of ownership.

·       Thrives in a fast-moving, rapidly evolving environment, continuously improving processes

·       Ability to work independently, lead multiple projects, and drive initiatives to deadline in a fast-paced environment.

·       Skilled at balancing strategy and delivery, with a hands-on approach when needed

·       Brings external perspective and a forward-looking, market-aware mindset

·       Embodies Qiddiya’s culture of Play and high performance

Why Join Us?

·       Build a Real Legacy….an Actual City: Imagine being part of a team that's not just shaping an organization, but helping to build a unique city from the ground up. This is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to contribute to a landmark project that will pioneer the future of 'Play'.

 

·       Shape the Future of Learning in Saudi Arabia: Bring together Saudi context, global learning practices, digital innovation, and enterprise capability building to create something distinctive and enduring.

jobs.title: Director - Parks and Green Spaces
jobs.description:
The Director – Green Spaces & Landscaping is responsible for providing strategic leadership, governance and portfolio oversight for all landscape, horticulture, irrigation, parks, green corridors, streetscapes and public realm softscape assets across Qiddiya City. The role establishes the green spaces operating model, sets standards, drives contractor and consultant performance, and ensures landscaped assets are safe, sustainable, resilient, visually high quality and guest-ready throughout the year. The Director acts as the senior technical authority for landscaping and irrigation operations, including local horticultural practices, climate-appropriate planting, water efficiency, plant health and knowledge of plant species native to the Arabian Peninsula.

Key Responsibilities

• Provide strategic leadership and governance for green spaces, landscaping, horticulture, irrigation, parks, green corridors, streetscapes and public realm

softscape assets across Qiddiya City.

• Establish and maintain the green spaces operating model, including standards, policies, inspection routines, maintenance strategies, service levels, KPIs, reporting

and escalation governance.

• Lead the operation and maintenance of parks, gardens, medians, boulevards, public realm landscapes, recreational landscapes and associated irrigation

infrastructure to ensure safe, healthy, attractive and guest-ready environments.

• Act as the senior technical authority for landscaping, horticulture, irrigation and public realm softscape operations, ensuring designs, handovers and operating

practices are maintainable, sustainable and aligned with local conditions.

• Drive sustainable landscape management, including water conservation, smart irrigation, climate-resilient planting, native and adaptive species strategies, biodiversity enhancement, green waste reduction and plant health management

Provide senior operational input into design reviews, value engineering, project gateways, testing, commissioning, handover and acceptance decisions for new landscape and irrigation assets.

• Oversee asset registers, lifecycle plans, condition assessments, replacement programmes, risk registers, performance dashboards and operational readiness activities for all green space and landscape assets.

• Direct contractor, consultant and service provider performance through clear scopes of work, technical standards, audits, SLA/KPI management, commercial challenge, corrective action plans and governance reviews.

• Manage annual operating and capital budgets, identifying cost optimisation, resource planning and service improvement opportunities without compromising safety, quality, sustainability or guest experience.

• Build, lead and develop the landscaping and green spaces team, setting clear priorities, developing capability, promoting accountability and ensuring disciplined, evidence-based decision making.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent qualification in Landscape Architecture, Horticulture, Agriculture, Irrigation Engineering, Environmental Science, Civil Engineering, Facilities Management or a related discipline.

• Relevant professional or technical qualification in horticulture, irrigation management, arboriculture, landscape operations, asset management, project management, sustainability or health and safety is desirable.

• Typically 12–15+ years’ experience across landscaping, horticulture, irrigation, parks, public realm, environmental operations, facilities management or city-scale O&M, including significant experience in a senior leadership role.

• Demonstrable experience leading large-scale landscape operations, public realm maintenance, irrigation networks, contractor governance, operational readiness, asset handover and lifecycle planning.

• Strong experience with local horticultural practices, climate-appropriate planting, water-efficient landscape management and plant species native to the Arabian Peninsula.

• Desirable experience within master-planned cities or communities, mixed-use developments, entertainment destinations, giga-projects, municipal environments, parks, public realm assets or large-scale developments within Saudi Arabia or the GCC.

jobs.title: Director - Public Realm - MAS 4001
jobs.description:

jobs.title: Director - Quality Assurance (DEL 1)

jobs.title: Director - Risk - 20013064 DA3
jobs.description:
Join Qiddiya Investment Company as a Director – Risk, where you'll play a vital role in our development management team meeting initiatives across various projects in the dynamic hospitality sector. In this exciting position, you will be instrumental in establishing and maintaining robust risk registers and reports that support sound decision-making and strategic objectives across our diverse projects.

The Director – Risk will be responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing comprehensive risk management strategies that align with the company's objectives, particularly in the context of large-scale development and construction projects. This role requires a deep understanding of risk management across various stages of project development, including planning and construction. The Director will ensure that risks are proactively identified, assessed, mitigated, and monitored to protect the Qiddiya’s interests and ensure successful project delivery.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

1. Establish the Qiddiya Program risk management framework, procedures, templates and processes, and seek continuous improvement.

2. Oversee the identification and assessment of risks associated with real estate development and construction projects, including financial, operational, technical, and legal risks.

3.  Conduct regular risk assessments and scenario analyses for ongoing and future projects to understand potential exposures.

4.  Ensure risk registers and databases are accurately maintained and regularly updated.

5. Design and implement risk mitigation strategies for high-impact risks, ensuring corrective actions are taken to minimize or eliminate risk exposure.

6.  Work closely with project teams to ensure risk management practices are embedded in project execution.

7.  Lead regular risk reporting including the development of key risk indicators (KRIs) to monitor the risk profile of project

8.     Ensure that risks are tracked and reported through all phases of project lifecycles and that any emerging risks are promptly escalated.

9.     Provide periodic updates and insights on evolving risks and potential future threats to project success.

10.  Lead and mentor the risk management team, promoting a culture of continuous learning and improvements.

11.  Provide the leadership to guide the Qiddiya Program and Portfolios in implementing the risk management plan

12.  Lead implementation of the Program and Project(s) risk management plan and produce Portfolio and Project Risk Register(s).

13.  Lead creation of the Program Risk Register and Program Risk Dashboard and other reports as may be specified, or ad hoc reports as required

14.  Ensure that the appropriate risk data is captured and that risk assessments are carried out on all aspects of the Qiddiya Program and Projects

15.  Provide leadership to ensure that risk treatments are identified, and effective monitoring and review processes are undertaken across the Qiddiya Program and Projects 

16.  Implement the necessary training and provide support to the Qiddiya Program and Project team(s) 

17.  Identify changes to the risk profile, personnel, the work, or the work environment that may change the effectiveness of risk treatments

18.  Monitor compliance against best practice standards and codes across the Qiddiya Program, including auditing the risk management plans, procedures and processes of the Executive Portfolios and assessing Risk Maturity in each area

19.  Review and approve Quantitative Risk modelling, including the Quantitative Schedule Risk Analysis (QSRA) and Quantitative Cost Risk Analysis (QCRA) reports.

20.  Collaborate with project teams to integrate risk controls into project plans, schedules, and budgets.

Requirements

Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in risk management, construction management, Business Studies, Finance or another relevant field.

Professional Certifications

Professional certification such as Chartered Risk Analyst (CRA), certified Risk Management Professional (CEMP), or Project Management Professional (PMP) are preferred

Years of Experience

10-15 years’ experience in risk management with significant experience in real estate development, construction, or large-scale infrastructure projects including at least 5 years in mega project construction/ development.

Proven track record of successfully implementing risk management strategies at the senior level.

Skills

Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and guide project teams.

Analytical and strategic thinker with a proactive approach to risk management.

In-depth knowledge of risk management tools, frameworks, and regulatory requirements specific to construction and development projects.

Ability to work under pressure, manage competing priorities, and meet tight deadlines.

Competencies

Strong decision-making and problem-solving abilities.

Effective collaboration and stakeholder management skills.

Strategic vision and forward-thinking risk management approach.

Financial acumen and understanding of project financing risks.

Working knowledge of Active Risk Management (ARM) software is preferred.

jobs.title: Director - Security Command & Integration
jobs.description:
The Director, Security Command & Integration provides strategic and operational leadership for the integration of security command, control, communications, intelligence, technology, incident coordination and commercial delivery across QIC Security Operations.

The role is accountable for ensuring the District Security Operations Centre (DSOC) operates as the central hub for situational awareness, operational coordination, information management and escalation, and that security contracts and commercial arrangements provide compliant, effective and value-driven services aligned with operational demand.

The role holder connects people, processes, technology, data and contracted services into a single operating model that supports daily security operations, major events, emergencies, elevated security postures and the transition from development to steady-state city operations.

Security Strategy and Transformation

Own the development and periodic review of the long-term strategy, target operating model and capability roadmap, aligning command, integration, resilience and service priorities with Qiddiya growth and the transition to steady-state city operations. 

Define the future balance of employed, contracted and specialist capability, ensuring workforce structures and sourcing models remain scalable, resilient, commercially sustainable and aligned with forecast operational demand. 

Security Command, Control & DSOC Operations

Define and maintain the integrated security command, control and coordination model, including roles, decision rights, escalation routes, command levels and interfaces with operational teams.

Provide executive oversight of the DSOC operating model, staffing, procedures, shift governance, briefings, logs, incident coordination and operational reporting.

Ensure timely collection, validation, analysis and dissemination of security information from personnel, systems, assets, contractors and external stakeholders.

Direct integrated coordination for significant incidents, events and elevated security postures, ensuring clear command, tasking, communication and decision logging.

Systems, Technology & Operational Integration

Lead the operational integration of CCTV, access control, alarms, communications, incident management, analytics and other security technologies into DSOC workflows.

Establish readiness, maintenance, resilience, fallback and recovery requirements for command-and-control technologies and communications.

Incident, Crisis & Major Event Readiness

Maintain command structures, duty arrangements, contact protocols, incident rooms and supporting documentation for routine and exceptional operations.

Coordinate the command, communications, reporting and contractor interfaces required for major events, VIP/VVIP activity and heightened security postures.

Plan and oversee table-top and live exercises that test DSOC, communications, escalation, continuity and cross-functional coordination.

Contracts, Commercial & Supplier Governance

Establish and oversee governance for security contracts, including performance cadence, KPI/SLA assurance, change control, risk, compliance and executive reporting.

Own the strategic commercial framework for outsourced security services, ensuring delivery models remain scalable, cost-effective and aligned to future city operational requirements.

Direct performance reviews, non-conformance management, recovery plans and escalation for persistent or high-risk supplier failure.

Requirements

Bachelor’s Degree essential, Master’s Degree preferred

Recognized qualification in Security Management, Risk Management, Emergency Management, Business, Operations, - --

Technology or a related discipline. ASIS CPP, CSMP or equivalent senior security certification preferred.

Formal senior-level training or evidenced professional competence in incident command, crisis management or security command-and-control operations.

Demonstrable commercial and contract-management competence relevant to outsourced security services.

Valid driving licence accepted for on-site driving in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

Extensive leadership experience in security operations, command and control, security systems integration, incident management or a closely related environment.

Proven accountability for an operational security control room, command centre, SOC/GSOC/DSOC or comparable multi-system coordination environment.

Demonstrated experience leading or supporting command arrangements for serious incidents, major events, emergencies and elevated threat conditions.

Strong operational understanding of CCTV, access control, alarms, communications, incident management platforms and system resilience.

Substantial experience governing complex outsourced security services, including KPIs, SLAs, change control, invoice assurance, claims, performance recovery and value-for-money challenge.

Experience designing, mobilising and improving integrated operating models, procedures, governance and management information.

Proven ability to advise executives, influence cross-functional leaders and manage complex internal, contractor and external stakeholder interfaces.

jobs.title: Director of Customer / Patient Experience & Administration (Healthcare) - QHC000
jobs.description:
Job Title: Director of Customer / Patient Experience & Administration 

Department: Sport Medicine Center  

Reports To: Senior Sport Medicine Director  

 

Role Summary 

The Customer / Patient Experience & Administration Director is responsible for overseeing the end-to-end patient journey and all front-of-house and administrative operations across the healthcare organization. 
The role ensures exceptional patient experience, efficient administrative processes, and seamless coordination between clinical and operational teams. 

Reporting to the Senior Sport Medicine Director, this position drives service excellence, operational efficiency, and patient-centered culture across registration, call centers, scheduling, billing support, and customer relations. 

 

Key Responsibilities 

1. Customer / Patient Experience Strategy 

  • Design and implement a customer /patient experience strategy aligned with organizational values and quality standards. 
  • Map and optimize the end-to-end customer / patient journey (access, appointment, arrival, clinical screening, treatment, discharge, and follow-up, and digital engagement). 
  • Lead customer /patient satisfaction improvement programs. 
  • Oversee customer/patient feedback systems, surveys, complaints, and resolution processes. 

2. Administrative Operations 

  • Oversee all administrative and front-desk functions including registration, scheduling, medical records, call center, and patient coordination. 
  • Ensure efficient services flow, accurate data capture, and timely documentation. 
  • Standardize SOPs for admissions, discharge, referrals, and insurance coordination. 
  • Monitor capacity, waiting times, and service level performance. 

3. Integration with Clinical, Rehab & Performance 

  • Work closely with all the departments and functions to ensure experience is embedded in care delivery. 
  • Ensure consistent experience standards across physicians, therapists, coaches, nurses, and front-line teams. 
  • Lead interdisciplinary experience governance forums. 

4. Customer /Patient Engagement & Communication 

  • Lead individual and patient liaison services and manage escalations and complex cases. 
  • Ensure clear, compassionate communication with individuals, patients and families. 
  • Coordinate multilingual services and accessibility support where required. 
  • Develop customer /patient engagement, retention, and loyalty programs. 
  • Lead communication, education, and experience personalization strategies. 
  • Oversee customer /patient communities, athlete support programs, and long-term care relationships. 

4. Quality, Compliance & Governance 

  • Ensure administrative processes comply with healthcare regulations, accreditation standards (CBAHI, JCI), and data privacy requirements. 
  • Implement quality assurance audits for patient experience and administrative services. 
  • Collaborate with GRC and Clinical Quality teams on patient rights and safety standards. 

5. Digital Customer /Patient Experience 

  • Oversee digital touchpoints including appointment systems, customer portals, mobile apps, and CRM platforms. 
  • Drive automation and paperless workflows to improve access, efficiency, and satisfaction. 

6. Performance Management & Reporting 

  • Define KPIs for customer /patient experience and administration (waiting time, complaints, first-call resolution, no-show rate). 
  • Develop dashboards and reports for the senior sport medicine director and  executive leadership. 
  • Use data to drive continuous improvement initiatives. 

7. Team Leadership & Development 

  • Lead and develop teams across reception, call center, patient relations, and administrative services. 
  • Ensure training in service excellence, communication, privacy, and healthcare regulations. 
  • Build a culture of empathy, professionalism, and accountability. 

8. Cross-Functional Coordination 

  • Work closely with Medical, Nursing, Finance (RCM), IT, and Marketing teams to ensure a seamless patient journey. 
  • Support service line expansion, new clinic openings, and operational readiness from a patient experience perspective. 
  • Build a patient-centric culture across the organization. 
  • Design and oversee service excellence training for all staff (clinical and non-clinical). 

Qualifications 

  • Bachelor’s degree in Healthcare Administration, Business Administration, Hospitality Management, or related field. 
  • Master’s degree preferred (MHA, MBA, Service Design, Healthcare Quality). 
  • 8+ years of experience in healthcare operations, patient experience, or service excellence roles. 
  • Strong knowledge of healthcare regulations, accreditation standards, and patient rights. 
  • Proven leadership in customer experience, administration, and service operations. 

 

Core Competencies 

  • Patient-Centered Service Design 
  • Healthcare Administration & Operations 
  • Customer Experience (CX) Leadership 
  • Process Optimization & Digital Enablement 
  • Communication & Conflict Resolution 
  • Performance Management & Analytics 
  • Team Leadership & Culture Building 
  • Regulatory & Accreditation Compliance

·       Demonstrates strong incident governance and crisis management capabilities, ensuring significant safety events are appropriately responded to, investigated, and addressed to protect people, maintain compliance, and strengthen organizational resilience.

jobs.title: HSE Coordinator (SPA5-50012968)
jobs.description:
Role Purpose

Coordinate health, safety, and environmental requirements across the Film Studio asset, supporting safe activation, handover, and day-to-day operations. Preferred Background

Technical & Functional Expectations

  • Strong knowledge of HSE standards, risk assessments, inspections, incident management, and permit-to-work processes.

jobs.title: Lead - SAP Basis
jobs.description:
Role Summary

The Assistant Manager – SAP Basis & Security is responsible for leading the administration, security, and governance of SAP systems across hybrid (cloud and on-premises) environments. The role ensures system stability, secure access management, compliance with audit requirements, and seamless integration across SAP applications including S/4HANA, BTP, Ariba, SuccessFactors, and MDG.

This position combines technical leadership, operational ownership, and governance accountability, aligned with enterprise-scale SAP landscapes and cybersecurity standards.

Key Responsibilities

1. SAP Basis Administration & Operations

  • Lead SAP system administration for S/4HANA and related platforms, including monitoring, performance tuning, and troubleshooting
  • Manage transports, system refreshes, upgrades, patches, and kernel updates
  • Monitor system health, batch jobs, logs, interfaces, RFCs, and database performance
  • Coordinate with infrastructure, cloud, and database teams to ensure availability and SLA compliance

2. SAP Security & Authorization

  • Design and maintain SAP roles and authorization structures aligned with least privilege and SoD principles
  • Manage user provisioning, role assignments, and authorization troubleshooting
  • Conduct user access reviews, emergency access (firefighter), and remediation activities
  • Provide audit evidence, access reports, and compliance documentation

3. SAP GRC & Access Governance

  • Configure and support SAP GRC modules (ARA, ARM, EAM, BRM)
  • Manage SoD rules, risk analysis, mitigation controls, and workflows
  • Support SAP IAG for cloud-based access governance across SAP SaaS applications
  • Lead periodic access certifications and audit remediation activities

4. SAP Cloud Security (BTP, IAS, IPS, Work Zone)

  • Administer SAP BTP subaccounts, role collections, destinations, and trust configurations
  • Configure IAS for SSO, identity federation, and authentication policies
  • Manage IPS for user and role provisioning across SAP systems
  • Support Work Zone access control and launchpad content configuration

5. SAP Application Security (MDG, Ariba, SuccessFactors)

  • Manage security and access controls across SAP MDG, Ariba, and SuccessFactors
  • Ensure secure integration between SAP S/4HANA and cloud systems
  • Support role design, provisioning, and access troubleshooting for business users

6. Identity & Integration Security

  • Design and implement SSO using SAML 2.0, OAuth, and IAS/IPS integration
  • Manage authentication flows across SAP ecosystem (S/4, BTP, SaaS apps)
  • Troubleshoot federation, certificates, tokens, and login failures

7. Compliance, Audit & Operations

  • Ensure adherence to internal security policies, audit requirements, and cybersecurity standards
  • Support audits with system logs, access controls, and compliance evidence
  • Participate in incident, change, and problem management processes
  • Prepare technical documentation and operational procedures

Required Skills & Experience

  • Strong experience in SAP Basis & Security administration
  • Expertise in SAP S/4HANA authorization and role design
  • Hands-on experience with SAP GRC Access Control and/or SAP IAG
  • Experience in SAP BTP security, IAS, IPS, and SSO configurations
  • Knowledge of integration security (RFC, OAuth, SAML, certificates)
  • Strong understanding of SoD, audit controls, and compliance frameworks
  • Experience supporting hybrid SAP environments (cloud + on-premise)

Preferred Qualifications

  • SAP certifications (Basis, Security, GRC, or BTP)
  • Experience in large-scale SAP transformation programs
  • Knowledge of SAP Cloud ALM or Solution Manager

Soft Skills (Assistant Manager Level)

  • Leadership mindset with ability to guide teams and vendors
  • Strong stakeholder communication (business, cybersecurity, and IT)
  • High ownership and accountability for critical systems
  • Ability to manage incidents under pressure
  • Proactive risk identification and continuous improvement focus

Education

  • Bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field

Experience Required

  • 8–10+ years in SAP Basis & Security
  • Strong hands-on experience with SAP S/4HANA and SAP cloud security
  • Experience in GRC/IAG implementation is highly preferred

jobs.description:

This role is responsible for driving the operational and commercial performance of all B2B and B2C booking channels, including OTAs, GDS platforms, travel trade networks, corporate travel channels, and direct booking platforms, ensuring Qiddiya’s tourism and destination products are accessible, competitively positioned, and commercially successful across all target markets.

The role involves leading distribution strategy initiatives, managing channel partnerships and performance, optimizing pricing and inventory management practices, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to maximize revenue generation and customer reach. The Manager – Distribution will work closely with Partnerships, Marketing, Technology, Finance, and Operations teams while managing and mentoring the Distribution team.

Responsibilities

  • Lead the development and execution of Qiddiya’s B2B and B2C distribution strategy across OTA platforms, GDS systems, travel trade channels, corporate travel partners, and direct booking channels to support overall commercial objectives.
  • Define and manage channel prioritization strategies to ensure optimal inventory allocation, rate parity, product visibility, and revenue performance across all distribution touchpoints.
  • Develop and oversee channel mix strategies that balance direct and indirect distribution channels to optimize profitability, market reach, and customer acquisition.
  • Manage Qiddiya’s OTA portfolio, including onboarding new platforms, negotiating commercial agreements, optimizing content quality, and improving product visibility and conversion performance.
  • Oversee GDS connectivity and ensure Qiddiya’s tourism inventory is accurately represented and bookable across key global distribution systems for corporate and agency markets.
  • Collaborate with Revenue Management, Finance, and Marketing teams to implement pricing strategies, promotional campaigns, and yield optimization initiatives across all channels.
  • Monitor booking trends, demand patterns, conversion metrics, cancellation trends, and competitor activity to recommend real-time pricing and distribution adjustments.
  • Develop and maintain distribution performance dashboards and reporting frameworks tracking revenue contribution, booking pace, channel conversion, cost of sale, and commercial KPIs.
  • Lead the onboarding and management of travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, MICE operators, and other trade distribution partners to strengthen Qiddiya’s global distribution footprint.
  • Oversee the enhancement and management of trade distribution platforms and partner portals, ensuring partners have access to inventory, booking tools, commission tracking, and marketing materials.
  • Coordinate partner training programs, trade familiarization (FAM) trips, and channel engagement initiatives to strengthen destination awareness and partner performance.
  • Own and manage the distribution technology ecosystem, including Channel Management Systems (CMS), Central Reservation Systems (CRS), OTA connectivity tools, and booking platforms, ensuring operational efficiency and system optimization.
  • Collaborate with Technology teams to improve platform integrations, distribution capabilities, and booking experiences across digital channels.
  • Prepare and present regular distribution performance reports, channel reviews, forecasts, and strategic recommendations to senior leadership and key stakeholders.
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives to enhance distribution processes, channel performance, operational efficiencies, and commercial outcomes.
  • Manage, mentor, and develop team members within the Distribution function to ensure high performance and professional growth.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Tourism, Hospitality Management, Marketing, or a related field; Master’s degree or MBA preferred.
  • At least 6+ years of relevant experience in distribution, revenue management, channel management, or commercial operations within tourism, hospitality, travel technology, or destination management sectors.
  • Proven experience managing OTA platforms, GDS connectivity, trade distribution channels, and booking ecosystems at a destination, hospitality, or tourism organization level.
  • Strong understanding of channel management systems, central reservation systems, revenue optimization practices, and dynamic pricing strategies.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing and managing trade distribution relationships with travel agencies, tour operators, DMCs, and corporate travel partners.
  • Strong analytical and commercial acumen with the ability to interpret performance metrics, optimize channel performance, and drive revenue growth initiatives.
  • Excellent stakeholder management, negotiation, communication, and relationship-building skills with the ability to collaborate across multiple functions.
  • Demonstrated leadership capability with experience managing teams and cross-functional initiatives.
  • Proficiency in distribution systems, CRM platforms, reporting tools, and data analytics platforms including Excel and Power BI.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; Arabic language skills are considered an advantage.
  • Knowledge of GCC and Saudi Arabia tourism, hospitality, and destination distribution landscape is strongly preferred.
  • Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced, dynamic environment with multiple priorities.

Benefits

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

jobs.title: Manager - Entertainment Strategy
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager – Entertainment Strategy plays a key role in shaping the strategic development of Qiddiya's entertainment assets, supporting the Associate Director in defining and delivering the long-term vision for the entertainment portfolio. The role is responsible for leading the early planning and concept development of new entertainment destinations, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's strategic objectives, guest experience ambitions, and commercial targets.

Key Responsibilities:

- Support the Associate Director of Entertainment Strategy in the execution of the overarching entertainment asset class strategies to ensure achievement of portfolio and assets' ambition, vision and objectives.

- Manage early design stages of development (ideation, pre-concept and concept) and contribute to all stages of development of new entertainment assets, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's entertainment offering and financial targets.

- Develop project documentation for distribution including, but not limited to, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Scope of Work (SOW), programmes, strategy briefs, and various project matrices.

- Manage consultants, collaborate with IP licensors (where relevant), and other third parties to ensure insights and recommendations are aligned with the overall scope of work, engagement objectives, and business expectations.

- Conduct analysis and research on entertainment asset benchmarks (theme parks, family entertainment centres, etc.) and strategic topics to support robust decision-making.

- Contribute to the development of initial go-live strategies, including operating models, pricing, sales and marketing, and manpower planning, while providing implementation support to other functions within Qiddiya.

- Prepare and deliver presentations and other materials for internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, secure approvals, and effectively communicate entertainment asset designs and strategic initiatives.

Requirements

- Bachelor's in Business Administration, Engineering or realted fields.

- 5+ years of experience in real estate and entertainment projects.

jobs.title: Manager - External Programs & Policies
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is spearheading a transformative giga project aligned with Saudi Arabia’s Vision 2030, focused on establishing a premier destination for entertainment, culture, and lifestyle. The Manager - External Programs & Policies (Local Content) plays a key role in advancing the Company’s commitment to local content integration, supplier development, and compliance with government policies.

Key Responsibilities:

1. Local Content Strategy and Implementation

·  Support the development and deployment of strategies aimed at enhancing local content across Qiddiya projects in alignment with PIF and national objectives.

·  Monitor and interpret local content regulations and government mandates to ensure full compliance.

·  Maintain documentation, reporting, and analysis related to local content performance and impact.

·  Collaborate closely with internal stakeholders, including procurement and supply chain teams, to embed local content targets into operational processes.

2. Supplier Development and Engagement

·  Assist in the design and execution of programs that build capacity and capabilities within local supplier bases.

·  Establish and maintain relationships with local suppliers, government agencies, and other relevant bodies to foster supplier growth and compliance.

3. Stakeholder Coordination and Compliance

·  Coordinate with internal teams to prepare for audits and ensure adherence to local content policies.

·  Serve as a liaison to external stakeholders including government officials and regulatory bodies.

·  Provide guidance and training to relevant teams on local content requirements and best practices.

Benefits

Join us in building the Destination City of the future!

jobs.title: Manager - F&B & Retail Systems Design
jobs.description:
The Manager – F&B & Retail Systems Design is responsible for leading the design and continuous enhancement of business solutions supporting the Food & Beverage and Retail domains. The role focuses on defining end-to-end business processes, solution design, and system interactions across operational, financial, customer engagement, and data platforms.

This position serves as the functional owner for cross-system business processes, ensuring that F&B and Retail applications operate seamlessly with enterprise platforms such as SAP, Blackline, Adaco, CRM, Loyalty, and Data & Analytics solutions. The role works closely with business stakeholders, vendors, the Master System Integrator (MSI), Enterprise Applications teams, Data teams, and Integration teams to design scalable solutions that support operational efficiency, financial accuracy, and exceptional guest experiences.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the functional design and delivery of business solutions supporting Food & Beverage and Retail operations.
  • Define end-to-end business processes spanning operational systems, financial platforms, customer engagement applications, and data ecosystems.
  • Work closely with IT Business Relations, business stakeholders, vendors, and MSI to translate business requirements into scalable solution designs.
  • Facilitate solution design workshops involving business users, enterprise application teams, data teams, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Ensure alignment of F&B and Retail solutions with enterprise platforms including: SAP Finance and Revenue Management, SAP Material Control and Inventory Management Blackline Financial Reconciliation, Adaco Procurement, Costing, and Inventory Management, Loyalty Platforms, CRM Platforms, Table Management Systems, QR Menu Solutions, Waiter Ordering Applications and Unified Data Platform and Analytics Solutions
  • Define business process flows, solution requirements, data ownership, and system interaction models across multiple platforms.
  • Ensure solution designs support operational efficiency, financial controls, inventory accuracy, customer engagement, and reporting requirements.
  • Drive continuous process improvements by leveraging technology capabilities and industry best practices.
  • Support application selection, tender evaluations, vendor assessments, and solution architecture discussions.
  • Act as the primary business solutions liaison between F&B, Retail, Enterprise Applications, Data & Analytics, vendors, and implementation partners.
  • Act as a functional escalation point for complex business process and cross-system issues.
  • Share responsibility for Level 2 support across F&B and Retail applications, ensuring timely resolution of business-impacting issues.
  • Monitor system effectiveness and identify opportunities to improve business processes, user experience, and operational efficiency.
  • Support troubleshooting and resolution of issues impacting financial reporting, inventory management, customer engagement, and operational workflows.
  • Work closely with vendors and internal teams to address application enhancements, defects, and optimization opportunities.
  • Support new system implementations, enhancements, testing activities, go-live readiness, and stabilization efforts.
  • Ensure business process documentation, solution designs, and operational procedures remain current and aligned with organizational standards.
  • Build strong working relationships with business stakeholders across F&B, Retail, Finance, Commercial, Data & Analytics, and Digital teams.
  • Provide functional leadership and guidance to project teams, vendors, and business users throughout delivery initiatives.
  • Mentor and support team members, including Assistant Managers and functional specialists.
  • Promote collaboration across application teams, enterprise platform teams, and delivery partners.
  • Support strategic planning activities related to the F&B and Retail technology roadmap.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems, or a related field.
  • 5-7 years of experience in application design, delivery, and support within large-scale enterprise environments.
  • Strong experience supporting F&B and Retail business operations and associated technology platforms.
  • Proven experience designing solutions involving finance, inventory, customer engagement, and reporting processes.
  • Experience working with platforms such as SAP, Adaco, Blackline, CRM, Loyalty, Retail Management Systems, and Analytics Platforms.
  • Demonstrated experience leading complex, multi-stakeholder solution delivery initiatives.
  • Experience collaborating with business users, vendors, system integrators, and enterprise application teams.
  • Previous experience within entertainment, hospitality, retail, leisure, or large mixed-use destinations is highly desirable.
  • Prior experience within similar large-scale integrated environments would be advantageous.

jobs.title: Manager - Festival Cultural Program
jobs.description:
Join us at Qiddiya, the future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture in Saudi Arabia. As one of the Kingdom’s most ambitious Vision 2030 giga-projects, Qiddiya is reimagining what’s possible — from world-class theme parks and arenas to immersive arts, motorsports, and outdoor adventures. Our mission is to create unforgettable experiences while driving economic growth and national talent development. At Qiddiya, innovation meets purpose, and every role contributes to shaping a vibrant new lifestyle destination. We are building more than just a city — we are building a legacy for generations to come. If you're driven by impact, creativity, and challenge, there’s a place for you here. Explore our current opportunities and be part of something extraordinary.

Role Purpose

Lead the planning and delivery of the core Cultural Festival programming, ensuring a high-impact, large-scale cultural program that drives visitor engagement and aligns with asset objectives.

 

Key Responsibilities

Festival Program Planning

·       Develop, produce, deliver, and manage a high-volume portfolio of festival programming, including coordination of over 1,400 performances, events, and cultural activities

·       Structure programming across multiple zones and time slots to optimize flow and engagement

·       Ensure alignment with overall programming strategy and visitor demand, in coordination with Commercial, Cultural Ecosystem, and Marketing teams

·       Identify, engage, and manage third-party program experts, producers, and cultural partners to develop, produce, and deliver festival programming

Large-Scale Program Delivery

·       Lead execution of all festival programming, ensuring coordination across multiple venues and activities

·       Manage daily program operations, schedules, and real-time adjustments

·       Ensure timely and seamless delivery of all performances and experiences

 

Performer & Participant Management

·       Coordinate onboarding, scheduling, and management of performers, artists, and contributors including regional, international, and government-affiliated participants and partners

·       Ensure readiness of all participants, including rehearsals, technical requirements and performance delivery

·       Manage high-volume and diverse participant groups, ensuring seamless coordination and consistent quality

Real-Time Operations & Optimization

·       Monitor program performance during the festival and adjust schedules dynamically

·       Address operational challenges in real time in coordination with Operations

·       Ensure continuity and quality under high-pressure conditions

Performance Monitoring

·       Track attendance, engagement, and program effectiveness across the festival

·       Identify high-performing and underperforming content

·       Provide insights to improve future festival programming

Key Success Metrics

·       Festival attendance and engagement

·       On-time delivery of programming

·       Visitor satisfaction

·       Revenue performance of festival programming against budget targets

·       Contribution of programming to overall asset financial performance

Required Skills & Competencies

·       Experience in large-scale event programming

·       Strong coordination and execution capability

·       Ability to operate in high-pressure environments

 

Requirements

-          6–10 years of experience, with a strong background in large-scale event programming, festival management, or live event delivery

-          Proven experience planning and delivering large-scale festivals, cultural events, or entertainment programs

-          Experience managing multi-day, high-volume events with multiple simultaneous activities

-          Strong understanding of event lifecycle management, from planning through live delivery

-          Demonstrated experience in managing live event programming under real-time conditions

-          Ability to oversee daily schedules, stage programming, and activity coordination

-          Experience handling last-minute changes, disruptions, and operational challenges during live events

-          Experience managing large numbers of performers, artists, and cultural contributors

-          Ability to coordinate rehearsals, technical requirements, and performance schedules

-          Experience ensuring readiness and smooth delivery across diverse participant groups

-          Experience managing programming across multiple stages, zones, or venues simultaneously

-          Ability to coordinate parallel activities while maintaining consistency and quality

-          Strong understanding of crowd flow, timing, and programming distribution

-          Experience leading teams, coordinators, and on-ground staff during live events

-          Experience in major national events, festivals, or large public events

-          Experience in cultural or entertainment programming environments

-          Experience in pre-opening or launching large-scale events is an advantage

jobs.title: Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is dedicated to transforming the entertainment landscape in Saudi Arabia, and we are seeking an experienced and analytical professional for the position of Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis. In this essential role, you will contribute to our financial strategy by supporting planning processes and delivering actionable insights that guide the company's decision-making.

As the Manager of Financial Planning and Analysis, you will be responsible for creating comprehensive financial plans, conducting forecasting processes, and analyzing performance metrics to ensure that Qiddiya is on track to meet its objectives. This includes collaborating closely with various teams to ensure financial alignment and drive the execution of strategic initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage the annual budgeting and forecasting processes, ensuring that financial targets align with the overall strategic goals of the organization.
  • Perform detailed variance analysis to evaluate monthly and quarterly performance against forecasts, identifying trends and areas for improvement.
  • Prepare and present financial reports and dashboards to provide clarity on financial performance and support decision-making.
  • Collaborate with department managers to develop robust financial plans that support business operations and strategic priorities.
  • Assist in the development of financial models to evaluate investment opportunities and long-term financial strategies.
  • Ensure compliance with financial regulations and standards, maintaining accuracy and integrity in all financial reporting.
  • Stay updated on industry trends and practices to enhance Qiddiya’s financial strategies.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in finance, accounting, or a related field
  • Advanced certifications such as CMA, CPA, or CFA are preferred
  • 7+ years of experience in financial planning and analysis or a similar field, ideally within large-scale projects or the entertainment sector
  • Proficiency in financial modeling and advanced Excel skills
  • Excellent analytical, communication, and interpersonal skills

jobs.title: Manager - FP&A Operating Assets
jobs.description:
The FP&A Manager for Operating Assets will be responsible for management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, financial planning, analysis, and performance monitoring of some of Qiddiya’s operating assets, including theme parks, hotels, golf courses, and sports venues. This role serves as a bridge between the FP&A department, the Finance Business Partner function, and the Asset Management/Operating Assets teams, working closely with FBPs to provide decision support, performance insights, and strategic financial recommendations.

Essential duties and responsibilities:

  • Lead the preparation of budgets, forecasts, and long-term financial plans for operating assets in collaboration with FBPs and Asset Management
  • Support scenario planning for pre-opening, ramp-up, and stabilization phases of assets
  • Track and analyze actual performance against budgets and forecasts, providing variance analysis and actionable insights to FBPs, asset managers, and leadership
  • Develop dashboards and performance reports in collaboration with the FP&A reporting team using tools like Power BI and Anaplan
  • Collaborate with FBPs as finance’s point of contact for asset management and operating teams, supporting operational leaders with financial insights
  • Partner with FBP and Asset Management on key decisions regarding pricing, operating models, and investment proposals
  • Evaluate new operating asset initiatives, expansions, and capital investment proposals from a financial perspective
  • Benchmark the performance of Qiddiya’s assets against industry standards and provide insights into key operational drivers such as attendance, occupancy, yield, and utilization
  • Ensure integration of operating assets’ financial data into FP&A tools, streamline reporting processes, and support governance to maintain data accuracy, consistency, and compliance
  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives for financial processes, reporting tools, and asset performance monitoring.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in finance or business management.
  • Professional certifications such as CPA, CA, or ACCA are highly recognized.
  • 7+ experience in finance and financial planning & analysis (FP&A) is required, preferably within asset-intensive sectors (such as hospitality, theme parks, sports, or entertainment).
  • Exhibited exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with expertise in assessing intricate financial and operational data to provide actionable recommendations.
  • Possess a robust business acumen with a comprehensive understanding of asset dynamics related to operating environments, including theme parks, hotels, sports venues, and entertainment assets.
  • Proven history of collaborating with cross-functional teams and effectively engaging with senior stakeholders.
  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills for conveying financial insights and preparing reports for executive leadership.
  • Capability to manage a multitude of priorities, deadlines, and projects within a dynamic, fast-paced setting.
  • A collaborative mindset with the ability to drive outcomes even without direct authority.

jobs.title: Manager - Gaming IP Partnerships
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced and dynamic Manager - Gaming IP Partnerships to join our team. In this role, you will be responsible for identifying, negotiating, and managing strategic partnerships related to gaming intellectual property (IP). This position offers an exciting opportunity to contribute to Qiddiya’s vision of becoming a leading entertainment destination by leveraging popular gaming brands and IPs to enhance the overall guest experience.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Monitor industry trends and competitive landscape to inform partnership strategies.
