  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or related field.
  • Minimum of 5 years of experience in partnership management, business development, or related roles, preferably within gaming, entertainment, or IP industries

Benefits

Comprehensive benefits package

jobs.title: Manager - Hospitality Asset Management - 20005483REP (HB4)
jobs.description:
About the Role

Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia’s future capital of entertainment, sports, and culture — a 360 km² mega-project just outside Riyadh. From F1-grade racetracks and theme parks to stadiums and performance venues, we’re creating a destination like no other. This is more than a project — it’s a national transformation. As construction accelerates, we’re hiring ambitious talent to help shape it. If you’re driven by scale, impact, and the chance to build something iconic from the ground up — Qiddiya is calling.

Job Summary:

We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Hotel Asset Manager to join our growing team. This role is ideal for a candidate with at least 3 years of experience in hospitality asset management or development, who can manage hotel assets from concept and planning stages through to operations and performance optimization.

The Asset Manager will play a key role in maximizing the value of hotel assets by overseeing operator relationships, monitoring performance, and supporting development and pre-opening activities for new hotel projects. The ideal candidate will be an Arabic and English speaker, and have a strong understanding of both the local and international hospitality landscape.

Key Responsibilities

  • Asset Oversight
    • Manage a portfolio of hotel assets across various stages – pre-development, development, pre-opening, and operations.
    • Monitor operator performance, ensuring alignment with ownership objectives and brand standards.
    • Analyze financial and operational KPIs (e.g., RevPAR, GOP, NOI, flow-through) and recommend strategies to improve performance.
  • Development & Pre-Opening
    • Support feasibility studies, brand selection, and contract negotiations (HMA, TA, LOI).
    • Coordinate with development teams, designers, and project managers to ensure delivery aligns with brand and operational requirements.
    • Assist in pre-opening budget reviews, FF&E procurement, and operational readiness activities.
  • Strategic Planning & Reporting
    • Prepare asset management reports, investment memos, and board presentations.
    • Work closely with finance, legal, and development teams to ensure smooth execution of asset strategies.
    • Assist in annual business plan and CapEx reviews with hotel operators.
  • Stakeholder Engagement
    • Serve as a key point of contact between ownership, operators, and external consultants.
    • Conduct regular site visits and performance review meetings with hotel GMs and management teams.
    • Ensure compliance with local regulations and ownership standards.

What We Offer

  • Career development opportunities within a rapidly growing hospitality investment platform
  • Collaborative and dynamic work environment
  • Exposure to high-profile hotel and mixed-use developments in Saudi Arabia
  • Competitive salary and performance-based bonus

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in hospitality management, or related field
  • Minimum 3 years of relevant experience in hotel asset management, development, or hospitality consulting
  • Strong financial acumen and ability to interpret hotel operating statements and budgets
  • In-depth understanding of financial principles, budgeting processes, and asset lifecycle management.
  • Excellent communication and negotiation skills and stakeholder management capabilities
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel, PowerPoint, and hospitality data tools (e.g., STR, HotStats)
  • Bilingual in Arabic and English (preferred)

Preferred Backgrounds

  • Prior experience working with or for international hotel brands or operators (e.g., Marriott, Hilton, Accor)
  • Prior experience working within the master developer organisation, developing large hospitality or mixed-use projects

The applications deadline is 31 July 2026.

jobs.title: Manager - Infrastructure Architecture
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is on the lookout for a visionary and detail-oriented Manager - Infrastructure Architecture to join our team. This role is pivotal in designing, implementing, and managing the architectural structure of our IT infrastructure. You will work collaboratively with various stakeholders to ensure that our infrastructural framework aligns with strategic business goals and supports our innovative projects aimed at creating exceptional entertainment experiences.

Key Responsibilities:

  • As part of the Enterprise Architecture team, the Application Architect is expected to ensure that the organization's digital and guest facing applications adheres to established policies, standards, and best practices while supporting the overall Enterprise Architecture governance framework.
  • ▪ Enforce adherence to established EA standards and guidelines throughout the design, implementation, and operation phases of various projects.
  • ▪ Review solution designs (high / low-level designs) in collaboration with solution architects to ensure alignment with Enterprise Architecture standards & guidelines, as well as non-functional requirements.
  • ▪ Provide technical and architectural oversight and guidance during the implementation of applications & digital solutions.
  • ▪ Assist in evaluating new solutions to ensure they align with Enterprise Architecture standards and guidelines.

  • ▪ Promote awareness of enterprise architecture governance principles and best practices among infrastructure, cloud & security teams, and other stakeholders.
  • ▪ Promote the establishment of internal structures and processes to guide, exploration, integration, and evaluation of emerging technologies, tools, and platforms to enable execution of digital initiatives

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field; a Master's degree is a plus.
  • A minimum of 6+ years of experience in infrastructure architecture or related fields.

Benefits

Join Qiddiya's team and enjoy a dynamic work environment that offers growth opportunities, a collaborative culture, and the chance to make a significant impact as our future Playmaker !

jobs.title: Manager - Investment Management - IM-011
jobs.description:
Qiddiya has an opportunity for an Investment Management professional to join our team and play a pivotal role in evaluating, originating, and managing real estate investment opportunities.

This is a hands-on, high-visibility role where you will collaborate closely with senior leadership to identify new investment opportunities, originate deals, and structure transactions. You will be expected to apply your expertise in financial modelling, corporate finance, and M&A to build the backbone of our investment framework and manage the financial performance of our real estate investments.

We are looking for a candidate with a strong background in investment management and financial modelling, ideally someone with experience in corporate finance, real estate investment, and private equity.

At the heart of our investment strategy, you will engage in market research, perform rigorous financial due diligence, and create sophisticated models to assess the profitability and risks of potential investments. You will work closely with both internal teams (including project managers, analysts, and associates) and external stakeholders (including banks, consultants, and legal advisors) to ensure the success of each project. Your ability to understand and implement complex financial structures and deal terms will be essential to driving long-term growth and profitability for the company.

This is an exciting opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and is eager to contribute to the strategic direction of a company at a pivotal stage in its growth journey.

Requirements

Education:

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or a related field.
  • MBA, CFA, or equivalent qualifications preferred.
  • Strong technical expertise in banking or investment management is essential.

Experience:

  • +7 years in investment management, financial modelling, or M&A advisory (preferably in real estate or private equity).
  • Experience in corporate finance, M&A modelling, and deal structuring, with a focus on real estate.
  • Strong experience from boutique investment banks or large real estate funds.
  • Prior exposure to the GCC region is highly desirable.

Technical Skills:

  • Proficiency in financial modelling, Excel, and corporate finance.
  • Familiarity with banking terminology and M&A processes.

Industry Knowledge:

  • Strong understanding of real estate investment strategies, trends, and market conditions in the GCC region.
  • Understanding of portfolio management and investment analysis.

Language Skills:

  • Fluency in English is required.
  • Proficiency in Arabic is a plus.

jobs.title: Manager - IT Strategy and Planning
jobs.description:
Job Purpose

The Manager – IT Strategy and Planning is responsible for developing, driving, and governing the Technology strategy, operating model, and strategic initiatives to ensure alignment with business objectives and organizational priorities. The role leads strategic planning activities, portfolio governance, performance management, budgeting coordination, and transformation initiatives across the Technology function to support Qiddiya's long-term vision and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Technology Strategy & Governance

  • Develop and maintain the Technology strategy, roadmap, and strategic initiatives aligned with corporate objectives.
  • Support the definition and execution of the Technology operating model, governance framework, and organizational priorities.
  • Establish and monitor Technology performance indicators, strategic objectives, and key results (OKRs/KPIs).
  • Facilitate governance forums, steering committees, and executive-level reporting.

Strategic Planning & Portfolio Management

  • Lead the annual Technology strategic planning and workforce planning cycles.
  • Develop and maintain the Technology portfolio roadmap and investment priorities.
  • Coordinate cross-functional initiatives to ensure alignment with business requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Monitor portfolio performance, risks, dependencies, and resource allocation.

Budgeting & Financial Planning

  • Lead the Technology budgeting and forecasting processes in collaboration with Finance and business stakeholders.
  • Monitor budget utilization, investment planning, cost optimization initiatives, and financial performance.
  • Support business case development and investment justification for strategic technology initiatives.

Performance Management & Reporting

  • Develop executive dashboards, performance reports, and management presentations.
  • Track strategic initiatives, milestones, deliverables, risks, and benefits realization.
  • Prepare reports and presentations for executive leadership, governance boards, and stakeholders.
  • Analyze technology performance metrics and recommend improvement initiatives.

Transformation & Continuous Improvement

  • Lead strategic transformation programs and organizational improvement initiatives.
  • Identify opportunities to optimize technology processes, governance, and operating models.
  • Drive continuous improvement and operational excellence initiatives across the Technology function.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business Administration, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Master's degree (MBA or equivalent) preferred.
  • Professional certifications such as PMP, ITIL, TOGAF, COBIT, or strategic management certifications are preferred.

Experience

  • Minimum 8–10 years of experience in Technology Strategy, IT Planning, PMO, Management Consulting, or Technology Governance.
  • Experience in large-scale organizations, digital transformation programs, or complex enterprise environments.
  • Proven experience in strategic planning, portfolio management, budgeting, and executive reporting.

jobs.title: Manager - Land Cost Valuation - Saudi National
jobs.description:
Manager – MDU Financing, Land Cost and Valuations

Qiddiya Investment Company is transforming the entertainment landscape in Saudi Arabia, and we are in search of a driven and insightful professional to fill the role of Manager – Land Cost and Valuations within our Master Development Unit. This role plays a central part in shaping the financial case for Qiddiya's districts as they move through planning and design, working closely with district master planning teams to ensure districts or projects are commercially sound and ready for key decision points.

You will develop and refine district-level financial models, translating detailed modelling assumptions into clear outputs that support planning and investment decisions. While strong technical skills are important, this role also requires close coordination and collaboration with stakeholders across the entire business. We value candidates with strong interpersonal skills, a collaborative and open-minded approach, and genuine enthusiasm for learning and growing in the role.

Requirements

jobs.title: Manager - Learning Design and Delivery
jobs.description:

Assessment, Measurement & Learning Impact

·       Proven track record of designing and delivering blended training programs and curriculum that create impact and drive higher business and human performance and compliance.

·       Experience in developing interactions, learning games, activities or assessments that reinforce learning.

·       Proficiency in managing multiple learning or business projects simultaneously.

·       Understand skills-based education, data-informed learning journeys and immersive storytelling.

·       Experience using best-in-class learning technologies for content creation and learning experience.  Experience using Sana Learn would be advantageous.

·       Experience with, or an interest in AI Prompt-driven development, would be advantageous.

·       Flexibility and adaptability in responding to changing business requirements.

·       Ability to effectively manage and prioritize workload and deliver to tight deadlines.  

·       Demonstrated strong written and verbal skills in English.

·       Demonstrated proficient use of enterprise-level software, such as Microsoft 365 or similar

·       Ability to work collaboratively in a team environment and across multiple departments, proven ability to empathize across cultures and different teams.

·       Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and conflict resolution skills. 

Skills & Capabilities

·     Passionate about creating playful learning experiences that create serious outcomes

·     Instructional designer mindset with a focus on creating positive business outcomes

·     Technical ability with learning authoring tools and the interface with learning technologies

·     Exceptional ability to use storytelling to create powerful learning outcomes

·     Highly organized, ability to simplify complex content into impactful learning

·     Excellent problem‑solving skills with a proactive approach to improvement

·     Highly collaborative communicator who can work across HR, IT, vendors, and business teams

·     Curious, adaptable, and energized by the growth and performance of people

 

 

Why Join Us? 
• Build a Real Legacy….an Actual City:  Imagine being part of a team that's not just
shaping an organization but helping to build a unique city from the ground up. This
is a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to contribute to a landmark project that will
pioneer the future of 'Play'.

leading PIF organization, where your expertise will directly shape the landscape of
talent and leadership, fueling the engine of development for the Kingdom.

nationalities, creating a vibrant and enriching environment embedded in a strong
Saudi culture. Experience the power of diverse perspectives and build a global
network.

jobs.title: Manager - Operational Readiness
jobs.description:
Develop, maintain, and govern the integrated Operational Readiness schedule, ensuring OR activities, milestones, and dependencies are aligned with asset delivery timelines, trial operations, and opening dates. Act as the single source of truth for OR programme scheduling and provide early visibility of risks to readiness milestones.

Key Responsibilities

  • Build and maintain the integrated OR master schedule in Primavera P6 covering all readiness workstreams: workforce mobilisation, training, systems readiness, SOPs, permits and licensing, FF&E/OS&E, trial operations, and handover.
  • Align OR schedules with project delivery milestones, stage gates, and asset opening dates, maintaining interfaces with PMO and delivery partner schedules.
  • Develop countdown plans and T-minus schedules for asset openings, including trial operations and soft opening phases.
  • Track progress against baseline, identify slippage and critical path impacts, and escalate risks to readiness milestones with recovery options.
  • Produce scheduling reports, dashboards, and lookaheads using Power BI and Excel for OR leadership and governance forums.
  • Coordinate schedule inputs from functional leads and consolidate updates on an agreed cadence.
  • Maintain schedule change control, baseline management, and documentation of assumptions and dependencies.
  • Support workforce ramp-up planning by aligning recruitment, onboarding, and training timelines with operational need dates.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management, Business Administration, or related field.
  • 5–8 years of scheduling/planning experience, ideally within operational readiness, giga-projects, entertainment/hospitality openings, or large-scale infrastructure.
  • Demonstrated hands-on Primavera P6 expertise, including baseline and change control on complex programmes.
  • Experience supporting asset openings, trial operations, or commissioning-to-operations transitions strongly preferred.
  • PMP, PMI-SP, or equivalent certification an advantage.

Offering a comprehensive compensation and benefits package.

  • Professional certifications in tourism, destination management, or commercial management, such as CDME or CTA, are advantageous.

jobs.title: Senior Director - Land Valuation
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is transforming the entertainment landscape in Saudi Arabia, and we are in search of a strategic and commercially driven professional to fill the role of Senior Director – Land Valuation within our Master Development Unit Financing team. This position is pivotal in shaping and maximising the commerciality of Qiddiya’s masterplan - establishing the valuation methodology and market intelligence that directly inform land sale strategy, district financial outcomes, and investment decisions as districts move through planning, design, and delivery.

As Senior Director – Land Valuation, you will lead the valuation function within Master Development Financing, establishing land valuation process, policies and benchmarks, which underpin district financial outcome and land sale strategy. You will manage relationships with external valuers, commissioning and reviewing valuation exercises to ensure quality and consistency. You will contribute to the entire Land Cost and Valuation workstream within MDU Financing and working with district teams closely to translate valuation intelligence into commercial recommendations.

Day to day you will be engaging with senior stakeholders across Master Development, district teams, Asset business units, and executive leadership. Outstanding commercial acumen, strategic leadership, and the ability to influence and drive outcomes at the executive level are essential, as is a strong track record in land or real estate valuation methodology at scale. A registered valuer designation (RICS), and prior experience valuing land within a large-scale master-planned or giga-project development, are strongly preferred.

 

Key Responsibilities

·       Lead land valuation methodology and benchmarking across all districts, ensuring consistency and rigor in how land value is assessed and applied

·       Contribute to shaping Qiddiya's land sale / leasing strategy by translating valuation insight and market benchmarking into commercial recommendations

·       Support land transactions and deal execution by providing market valuation input to commercial assessments

·       Manage relationships with external valuers, commissioning valuation exercises and reviewing outputs for quality, accuracy, and market alignment

·       Present valuation findings and recommendations to senior leadership and executive stakeholders, supporting key planning and investment decisions

·       Provide valuation input to Asset Business Units for plot- and asset-level commercial assessments

·       Develop Qiddiya's valuation policy and processes, embedding valuation thinking into district planning from an early stage

·       Work closely with district masterplanning teams and the broader business to drive district valuation exercise, align assumptions and achieve commercial objectives

·       Work closely with wider MDU Financing team, support interaction between land cost and district feasibility workstreams

·       Support balance sheet exercises, working with Finance and PIF as required.

·       Understand and stay up to date on market conditions, comparable transactions, and valuation best practice to continually inform and refine Qiddiya's approach

Requirements

  • Bachelor or Master's degree in valuation, real estate, economics, finance or a related field
  • A minimum of 15-20 years of relevant experience in land or real estate valuation
  • Registered valuer background strongly preferred
  • Institutional real estate or land development experience
  • Established expertise in land valuation methodology and market benchmarking
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with demonstrated ability to engage and present to senior leadership and executive audiences
  • Advanced Excel and financial modeling proficiency
  • Exceptional critical thinking and strategic problem-solving abilities
  • Strong leadership capabilities, with demonstrated success in building and developing high-performing teams
  • Extensive Regional (GCC/Saudi) market experience preferred

jobs.title: Senior Expert - MarTech
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Digital is seeking a hands-on Senior Expert - MarTech to provide technical ownership across Qiddiya’s MarTech and digital experience platforms.

The role will be responsible for the technical design, implementation oversight, integration quality, release readiness, platform reliability and operational support of MarTech capabilities across Adobe Experience Cloud, AEM / AEMaaCS, AEP, AJO, CJA, Target, DAM / Content Hub, Sprinklr, Workfront, analytics, tagging and related integrations.

This is a senior individual contributor role with strong technical authority. While the role may not have direct line-management responsibility, it will provide technical leadership to vendor engineering teams and remain accountable for technical quality, resilience, reliability, security, performance and operational readiness of the MarTech platform landscape.

A key objective is to eliminate black-box delivery, retain critical MarTech technical knowledge within Qiddiya, and ensure Qiddiya remains in control of its MarTech platforms, integrations and release processes.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take technical ownership of MarTech platforms, integrations and delivery quality across Adobe, AEM/AEMaaCS, AEP, AJO, CJA, Target, DAM / Content Hub, Sprinklr, Workfront and analytics.
  • Define and maintain MarTech technical architecture, integration patterns, engineering standards, release approach and technical roadmap.
  • Provide hands-on technical leadership across solution design, development, configuration, integration, testing, deployment, release and production support.
  • Lead and challenge vendor engineering teams, ensuring compliance with Qiddiya Digital standards and MarTech architecture principles.
  • Review and approve technical designs, APIs, data models, event schemas, tracking specifications, integration flows, code quality and major technical decisions.
  • Support AEMaaCS governance, Cloud Manager pipelines, environment strategy, release controls, shared component standards and multi-SI code management.
  • Own technical quality for analytics and tagging, including data layer, Adobe Tags / Launch, WebSDK / MobileSDK, UTM governance, CJA data flows and reporting reliability.
  • Support AEP / AJO / CJA / Target enablement, including profile, audience, journey, decisioning, personalisation, experimentation and reporting use cases.
  • Ensure MarTech solutions are secure, scalable, observable, resilient, maintainable, reusable and cost efficient.
  • Validate vendor deliverables using clear technical acceptance criteria, test evidence, deployment checks and production readiness criteria.
  • Ensure appropriate automated testing, CI/CD controls, monitoring, logging, alerting, access controls and operational runbooks are in place.
  • Validate release plans, rollback procedures, capacity considerations, integration testing, disaster recovery and production readiness.
  • Lead technical incident management, root-cause analysis and permanent remediation for MarTech-related issues.
  • Identify and manage technical debt, architecture risks, recurring incidents, performance issues and operational weaknesses.
  • Maintain technical documentation, architecture decisions, integration specifications, release notes, runbooks and support procedures.
  • Drive knowledge transfer from vendors and ensure Qiddiya can independently operate, govern and evolve the MarTech ecosystem.

Requirements

  • 8+ years of software engineering, technical lead, solution architecture or senior development experience in digital platforms, MarTech or customer-facing technology environments.
  • Strong hands-on technical capability and ability to challenge implementation-level decisions.
  • Experience with Adobe Experience Manager, AEMaaCS, Adobe Experience Cloud or equivalent enterprise digital experience platforms.
  • Strong understanding of APIs, microservices, event-driven architecture, data flows, integrations, identity, consent, customer profiles and distributed systems.
  • Experience with analytics and tagging technologies, preferably Adobe Tags / Launch, WebSDK / MobileSDK, CJA, data layer design, UTM governance and campaign tracking.
  • Experience with CI/CD, cloud environments, release management, automated testing, observability, performance engineering, security and production operations.
  • Experience overseeing vendors, system integrators or outsourced engineering teams.
  • Strong incident management, root-cause analysis and problem-management experience.
  • Strong documentation, communication, stakeholder management and technical decision-making skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Development Strategy (SPA4-COBU-50011627)
jobs.description:
This is a strategy-focused role within the Office Business Unit, responsible for shaping Qiddiya's office portfolio and ensuring products, phasing, and development plans are aligned with market demand and business objectives.

 The role combines market intelligence, commercial analysis, and stakeholder engagement to support the delivery of commercially successful office developments across Qiddiya.

  • Develop office portfolio, asset, and product strategies aligned with market demand and business objectives.
  • Prepare business cases, strategic recommendations, and management presentations.
  • Conduct market research, benchmarking, and occupier analysis to inform development decisions.
  • Assess office market risks and opportunities and recommend mitigation strategies.
  • Define office products, tenant positioning, and customer value propositions.
  • Support the identification of anchor occupiers, strategic partners, and key demand drivers.
  • Work with Development, Design, Delivery, Leasing, and Operations teams to optimise project outcomes.
  • Develop recommendations on project phasing, prioritisation, and investment decisions.
  • Manage external consultants and advisory workstreams.
  • Support engagement with key stakeholders both internally and externally.

 

 

Requirements

  • 7+ years' experience in management consulting, real estate strategy, development, or a related field.
  • Strong understanding of real estate markets, occupier requirements, and development economics.
  • Experience in market analysis, business planning, and strategic recommendations.
  • Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder management skills.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Digital Twin
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is on the lookout for an experienced Manager - Digital Twin to lead the implementation and development of digital twin technologies across our projects. In this role, you will be responsible for leveraging digital twin methodologies to enhance operational efficiencies, improve decision-making, and drive innovation throughout the organization.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead the execution of Qiddiya's Digital Twin project, ensuring the timely delivery of the strategy, roadmap, and MVP.
  • Act as the primary liaison with internal teams, leadership, and external vendors to drive project alignment and success.
  • Develop and oversee a the Digital Twin strategy that integrates with existing digital infrastructure, including BIM, GIS, IoT, and the Unified Data Platform (UDP).
  • Manage the implementation of the Minimum Viable Product (MVP) to validate selected use cases and demonstrate the value of the Digital Twin.
  • Create a roadmap for scaling the Digital Twin framework across Qiddiya, identifying new use cases and ensuring continuous improvement.
  • Conduct stakeholder workshops, interviews, and site visits to gather insights and align project objectives with business needs.
  • Oversee vendor relationships, ensuring compliance with cybersecurity policies, data governance standards, and project requirements.
  • Manage project budgets, conduct cost-benefit analysis, and build business cases to demonstrate the return on investment (ROI) of implementation
  • Ensure organizational readiness for scaling Digital Twin initiatives, including defining new roles, training programs, and process improvements.

Requirements

  • A Bachelor's degree or higher in Engineering, Smart Cities, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related discipline.
  • 6 years of experience in digital transformation, smart infrastructure, or similar fields. Demonstrated experience in overseeing large-scale technology projects, ideally involving Digital Twin, Building Information Modeling (BIM), Geographic Information Systems (GIS), or Internet of Things (IoT). Skilled in stakeholder management and vendor coordination.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Document Control - Urban Core (REQ740)
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager – Document Control is responsible for establishing, leading, and continuously improving document control, information management, and records governance processes across the Urban Core portfolio. The role will ensure all project documentation, deliverables, correspondence, approvals, drawings, BIM information, technical submissions, and contractual records are managed in accordance with project governance requirements, quality standards, and regulatory obligations.

As a key member of the project delivery team, the position will oversee document control operations across multiple mixed-use developments, ensuring timely, accurate, and auditable management of project information throughout the project lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement document control strategies, procedures, standards, and governance frameworks across the Urban Core portfolio.
  • Lead and manage all document control activities relating to design, procurement, construction, testing, commissioning, and handover.
  • Oversee document management systems (Aconex, PMIS, CDE, SharePoint, or equivalent) ensuring data integrity, accessibility, and compliance.
  • Manage document workflows, transmittals, reviews, approvals, superseded documentation, and records retention processes.
  • Establish reporting dashboards and KPIs to monitor document control performance and information management effectiveness.
  • Coordinate with design consultants, contractors, PMCs, and internal stakeholders to ensure timely submission and processing of project documentation.
  • Support audits, governance reviews, and QA/QC processes by maintaining complete and traceable project records.
  • Ensure all project information complies with organizational policies, contractual requirements, and regulatory obligations.
  • Lead, mentor, and develop document control teams across multiple projects and workstreams.
  • Support project close-out and operational handover by ensuring accurate and complete transfer of asset information and records.

Core Competencies

  • Information Governance & Records Management
  • Document Control & Data Integrity
  • Project Delivery Support
  • Process Improvement
  • Stakeholder Coordination
  • Team Leadership & Development
  • Quality Assurance & Compliance
  • Reporting & Performance Management

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Management, Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline.
  • At least 7+ years of experience in document control, records management, information management, or project controls within large-scale construction or mixed-use development projects.
  • Proven experience managing document control functions on complex, multi-stakeholder developments.
  • Strong knowledge of electronic document management systems (EDMS) and Common Data Environments (CDE).
  • Excellent understanding of document governance, quality management systems, and project delivery processes.
  • Strong leadership, stakeholder management, communication, and organizational skills.
  • Experience working on large-scale mixed-use, urban development, infrastructure, or giga-project environments is highly desirable.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Enterprise Skills Academy & Learning Partner
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager – Enterprise Skills Academy & Learning Partner plays a key role in strengthening capability across Qiddiya, with three primary areas of focus.

 First, the role serves as the learning partner to Qiddiya Technology (QTech), shaping and delivering skills development across technical, digital, data, AI, and the professional capabilities required for high-performing technology teams.

 Second, the role drives the development of digital skills across the wider organization, helping teams adopt technology-enabled ways of working and build the practical capabilities needed to use digital tools effectively in their roles.

 Third, the role partners with selected business units and corporate functions to support broader capability building where there are clear business needs, ensuring learning solutions are aligned to performance outcomes and integrated into the wider enterprise learning approach.

 It requires someone who is incredibly future focused and comfortable working at the intersection of technology, capability building, and business performance. They will be critical to translating complex needs into practical, high-impact learning solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Learning Partnership & Advisory
  • Act as the main learning partner to QTech, understanding priorities, delivery pressures, and capability gaps.
  • Advise and deliver solutions on how technology, digital, data, AI, and the professional skills that support strong tech teams can improve delivery and performance
  • Act as a single point of coherence across multiple QTech learning initiatives, reducing duplication and improving visibility and prioritization
  • Lead the development of digital skills across the wider organization, helping teams work effectively in a more technology-enabled environment.
  • Partner with other business units and corporate functions where there is a clear need to build capability that improves business outcomes. 
  • Skills & Role‑Based Pathway Development
  • dentify priority roles, teams, and workflows where capability uplift (including AI) will materially improve performance.
  • Translate business priorities into targeted, contextualised learning pathways — avoiding one‑size‑fits‑all models.
  • Enterprise Skills Academy Activation
  • Ensure the Enterprise Skills Academy supports both deep specialist capability and the professional and delivery capabilities required for technology teams and digitally enabled functions to perform effectively.
  • Put in place a clear learning structure, using the AI-native LXP to as well as other delivery mechanisms such as face to face to bring together programs, pathways, partners, and performance support.
  • Coordinate internal and external delivery partners, ensuring solutions are contextualized for Qiddiya environments and integrated into the LXP/LMS ecosystem.
  • Partner with Data, AI, and Digital teams to embed responsible AI practices, safe use standards, and contextual AI coaching into the learning approach.
  • Governance, Measurement and Continuous Improvement
  • Work with Data, AI, and IT governance functions to ensure learning aligns with enterprise architecture, security, and compliance requirements.
  • Define and track success measures focused on behaviour change, improved delivery outcomes, and confidence in role — not attendance or completion.
  • Continuously refine learning pathways, academy offering, and engagement models based on performance insights and business feedback.

Requirements

  • 7+ years’ experience in learning, capability development, digital transformation, or technology‑focused talent roles.
  • Proven experience partnering with technology or digitally enabled organizations (IT, Digital, Data, AI, Cloud, Cyber, Engineering).
  • Strong understanding of digital and AI-driven capability building, and how skills translate into improved delivery and performance.
  • Experience designing or leading learning academies, capability frameworks, or role-based pathways.
  • Experience working cross-functionally, ideally including both technical teams and business or corporate functions.
  • Comfortable analyzing performance data and translating insights into practical decisions.
  • Skills & Capabilities
  • Able to translate business priorities into practical capability solutions.
  • Strong understanding of technology-driven work and the skills required to perform effectively in digital and AI-enabled environments.
  • Comfortable working with both technical and non-technical stakeholders and adapting approach accordingly.
  • Strong facilitation, consulting, and stakeholder-engagement skills.
  • Well organized and able to manage multiple initiatives and partners without losing focus.
  • Curious, pragmatic, and motivated by improving how people work, not just delivering training

Benefits

Comprehensive benefits package

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Entertainment Strategy
jobs.description:
Overview:

The Senior Manager – Entertainment Strategy plays a key role in shaping the strategic development of Qiddiya's entertainment assets, supporting the Associate Director in defining and delivering the long-term vision for the entertainment portfolio. The role is responsible for leading the early planning and concept development of new entertainment destinations, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's strategic objectives, guest experience ambitions, and commercial targets.

Key Responsibilities:

- Support the Associate Director of Entertainment Strategy in the execution of the overarching entertainment asset class strategies to ensure achievement of portfolio and assets' ambition, vision and objectives.

- Manage early design stages of development (ideation, pre-concept and concept) and contribute to all stages of development of new entertainment assets, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya's entertainment offering and financial targets.

- Develop project documentation for distribution including, but not limited to, Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Scope of Work (SOW), programmes, strategy briefs, and various project matrices.

- Manage consultants, collaborate with IP licensors (where relevant), and other third parties to ensure insights and recommendations are aligned with the overall scope of work, engagement objectives, and business expectations.

- Conduct analysis and research on entertainment asset benchmarks (theme parks, family entertainment centres, etc.) and strategic topics to support robust decision-making.

- Contribute to the development of initial go-live strategies, including operating models, pricing, sales and marketing, and manpower planning, while providing implementation support to other functions within Qiddiya.

- Prepare and deliver presentations and other materials for internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment, secure approvals, and effectively communicate entertainment asset designs and strategic initiatives.

Requirements

- Bachelor's in Business Administration, Engineering or realted fields.

- 7+ years of experience in real estate and entertainment projects.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Feasibility and Business Plans
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking an experienced Senior Manager – Feasibilities and Business Plans to lead the financial and commercial feasibility analysis of residential apartment developments across the Qiddiya master plan. This role is critical in ensuring that apartment schemes are commercially viable, optimally configured, and aligned with market demand, development strategy, and investment return requirements. 

The role requires deep expertise in residential apartment feasibility, including unit mix optimization, pricing and absorption analysis, cost benchmarking, efficiency ratios, and sensitivity testing, working closely with Development, Design, Sales, and Cost Planning teams. 

Key Responsibilities 

Residential Apartment Feasibility Leadership 

  • Lead the end‑to‑end preparation, review, and validation of feasibility studies and business plans for residential apartment projects, across multiple densities, typologies, and development phases 
  • Drive apartment‑level feasibility analysis, including unit mix, sizing, efficiency (NIA/GIA/GFA), pricing, and absorption assumptions 
  • Ensure all apartment schemes meet defined investment hurdle rates and align with Qiddiya’s residential strategy and governance requirements 

Financial Modeling & Unit Economics 

  • Build, review, and manage detailed financial models for apartment projects, incorporating:  
  • Unit level revenues and sales phasing 
  • Construction and development costs 
  • Cashflow timing, IRR, NPV, and sensitivity analysis 
  • Evaluate the financial impact of changes in apartment design, density, efficiency, specifications, and unit configurations 
  • Stress test feasibility outcomes against market, cost inflation, and delivery risks 

Cross‑Functional Coordination 

  • Work closely with Development, Design, Cost Planning, Sales, and Planning teams to ensure apartment designs are financially optimized from early concept through investment approval 
  • Challenge inputs and assumptions to maintain commercial discipline and realism 
  • Act as the primary financial interface for apartment projects through internal stage gate approvals 

Investment Governance & Decision Support 

  • Prepare investment‑ready feasibility packs, business plans, and financial summaries for senior management and investment committees 
  • Clearly articulate risks, sensitivities, and mitigation strategies related to apartment developments 

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Economics, or a related discipline (Master's degree is a plus) 
  • 10+ years’ experience in feasibility analysis, business planning, or investment analysis with a strong focus on residential apartment developments 
  • Proven experience working with large‑scale residential or mixed‑use developments, preferably within institutional or giga‑project environments 
  • Strong stakeholder‑management skills and experience presenting to senior executives and investment committees 
  • Strong financial modeling skills and experience with financial analysis software (e.g. EstateMaster) 
  • Excellent interpersonal and communication skills for effective collaboration with cross-functional teams

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Finance Management Reporting and Consolidation (CORS 252)
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager – Management Reporting & Consolidation plays a critical role within Qiddiya’s FP&A function, supporting the Director in delivering high-quality management reporting, financial consolidation, and advanced analytics.

This role is responsible for leading the preparation of management packs, executive reporting, and scenario models, while strengthening reporting frameworks, system integration, and data governance across the organization. The Senior Manager will drive operational excellence in reporting processes, support system optimization initiatives, and contribute to automation and digital transformation efforts.

Success in this role requires strong expertise in Anaplan (or similar planning tools), Power BI (mandatory), financial consolidation, and data architecture, combined with the ability to translate complex financial information into clear, actionable insights for senior stakeholders.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead monthly and quarterly financial consolidation processes across entities, ensuring accuracy, completeness, and timeliness.
  • Oversee the preparation of management packs, executive presentations, and Board-level materials in coordination with the Director.
  • Translate complex financial and operational data into structured, visually compelling reports and dashboards.
  • Act as a key Anaplan power user, supporting model development, enhancements, and scenario / what-if analysis.
  • Lead Power BI dashboard development and automation initiatives to enhance reporting efficiency and insight generation.
  • Ensure alignment and data integrity across Anaplan, SAP S/4HANA, and reporting platforms.
  • Support FP&A teams with advanced financial analysis, KPI tracking, and performance insights across Corporate and Development teams.
  • Build and maintain robust financial models to support planning, forecasting, and strategic initiatives.
  • Standardize reporting templates, KPI frameworks, and action trackers to enhance governance and transparency.
  • Partner closely with accounting, treasury, development finance, and other stakeholders to ensure data accuracy and process alignment.
  • Manage and develop a small team of analysts, fostering analytical rigor, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Identify and implement process improvement and automation opportunities to streamline consolidation and reporting cycles.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business, or related field (Master’s degree preferred).
  • CPA, CA, ACCA, or MBA preferred.
  • 10+ years of experience in FP&A, financial consolidation, or management reporting within complex organizations.
  • Minimum 6 years in a managerial role overseeing reporting or consolidation activities.
  • Experience in master development, construction, infrastructure, real estate, or capital-intensive industries preferred.
  • Alternatively, experience within large multinational organizations (USD 1Bn+ annual revenue, capex, or opex) with demonstrated progression.
  • Big 4 or Tier 1 consultancy experience is highly preferred.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Financial Planning and Analysis (CORS 251)
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager leads project controls and financial governance across assigned projects or portfolios, ensuring robust oversight of contracts, budgets, schedules, risks, and reporting. The role provides strategic financial insight, strengthens control frameworks, and supports senior leadership in informed decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

  • Manage contract variations, change orders, and extension of time/cost claims, ensuring proper evaluation, documentation, approvals, and reporting.
  • Oversee utilization of project contingencies and provisional sums, ensuring disciplined budget control and alignment with approved business cases.
  • Direct cost monitoring, forecasting, and variance analysis, providing clear insights and mitigation strategies to senior management.
  • Ensure integrity and reconciliation of data across SAP, Primavera P6, Unifier, BIM, and related systems.
  • Oversee monthly accrual reviews and financial close activities to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Provide high-level oversight of schedule changes and integrated cost/schedule impacts.
  • Lead risk and opportunity reviews, ensuring timely identification, assessment, and escalation of key exposures.
  • Act as a senior liaison between Finance, Commercial, and Project Delivery teams to ensure transparency and alignment.
  • Mentor and guide project controls teams, promoting governance, accountability, and continuous improvement.

Requirements

Bachelor’s degree

Working knowledge or certification on project tools such as: primavera, p6, unifier, SAP project module. (required)

Professional Certifications

Professional certifications such as CPA/ MBA are preferred

Certificate in Construction Law and Dispute Resolution – RICS or similar are preferred

Project Management Professional (PMP) is preferred.

8+ years of experience in Project Controls, or Development Finance as part of large construction company or large developer or PMC.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Fire, Life Safety Planning (MAS291)
jobs.description:
Qiddiya City – one of the world’s largest greenfield entertainment and sports cities, spanning a 366 km² masterplan in Saudi Arabia, comprising complex infrastructure, transportation systems, hospitality assets, entertainment venues, stadia, mixed-use developments and residential districts across all stages of planning, design and construction.

Depth of experience in a specific area: Extensive experience in Fire & Life Safety (FLS) engineering and design across complex masterplans, infrastructure and high-profile asset developments, with strong expertise in both prescriptive and performance-based fire engineering design. Demonstrated capability in developing and reviewing FLS strategies, smoke management systems, evacuation and egress strategies, firefighting access and emergency response planning, fire water infrastructure and integrated fire protection systems for large-scale and technically complex developments.

Strong understanding of Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA standards, IBC, IFC, Saudi Civil Defence requirements and relevant international fire engineering standards, with the ability to assess design compliance, alternative solutions and authority requirements across all project stages.

 

Role summary: The role supports the Master Developer Unit (MDU) Fire & Life Safety (FLS) team by leading and delivering specialist fire engineering, design review and advisory services across city-wide masterplanning, infrastructure and asset development projects. The post-holder is responsible for the development and review of FLS strategies and performance-based fire engineering solutions, while providing engineering leadership and guidance to internal stakeholders, Lead Design Consultants (LDCs), third-party FLS consultants and project delivery teams across all stages of design and construction.

Core responsibilities:

  • Lead the development and assurance of Fire & Life Safety design strategies across complex buildings, infrastructure, public realm, transport interfaces and large-scale masterplanned developments.
  • Act as a senior FLS engineering authority, providing clear direction on code compliance, design adequacy, fire strategy, life safety risk and buildability.
  • Review and challenge FLS design submissions, drawings, reports and calculations prepared by consultants, ensuring issues are identified early and resolved with robust engineering solutions.
  • Develop and assess fire engineering solutions for complex or non-standard designs, including alternative solutions, smoke control, evacuation, compartmentation, firefighting access and firefighting provisions.
  • Advise on the application of Saudi Building Code, Saudi Civil Defence requirements, NFPA standards and relevant international best practice across planning, design and construction stages.
  • Coordinate with architects, MEP, infrastructure, mobility, operations and delivery teams to ensure FLS requirements are properly integrated into the design, not treated as late-stage compliance comments.
  • Support authority engagement and third-party FLS reviews by preparing clear engineering positions, resolving comments and defending the design intent where required.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Fire Engineering is preferred; alternatively, candidates may hold a degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or another related engineering discipline from a recognized university.

Holding one of the following certifications is an advantage:

  • Membership of the Institution of Fire Engineers (MIFireE) or equivalent professional body
  • Chartered Engineer (CEng) or equivalent professional registration
  • Certified Fire Protection Specialist (CFPS)
  • NFPA Certifications
  • Performance-Based Fire Engineering, CFD Modelling or Smoke Control related certifications/training
  • PMP or equivalent project/design management certification is desirable for multidisciplinary coordination roles
  • 8–15 years’ experience in Fire & Life Safety engineering and design across large-scale mixed-use, infrastructure, hospitality, entertainment, transportation or giga-project developments.
  • Demonstrated experience in developing, reviewing and coordinating Fire & Life Safety strategies across all project stages including masterplanning, concept, schematic, detailed design and construction support.
  • Strong engineering expertise in means of egress, smoke management, firefighting access, fire water infrastructure, fire alarm and suppression systems, and passive fire protection systems.
  • Experience in performance-based fire engineering design including alternative solutions, smoke modelling, evacuation analysis and complex code compliance assessments.
  • Strong understanding of Saudi Building Code (SBC), NFPA standards, IBC, IFC, Saudi Civil Defence requirements and relevant international fire engineering standards and best practices.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Geotechnical (MAS5-20003552)
jobs.description:
Description:

The Director - Geotechnical will oversee all geotechnical and ground investigation activities across the Qiddiya Development which includes leading the execution of the Cliff Stabilisation Roadmap to ensure the long-term stability of the Qiddiya Tuwaiq cliff. This role is responsible for ensuring that geotechnical risks are identified, mitigated, and integrated into planning, design, and delivery activities at a city-wide level.

This role requires expertise in project management, geotechnical engineering, procurement, design management and stakeholder coordination. The Director will work across master planning, design, and delivery teams to ensure alignment with Qiddiya’s broader development objectives.

 

City-Wide Geotechnical & Ground Investigation Responsibilities:

  • Establish and lead a city-wide geotechnical and ground investigation strategy that aligns with Qiddiya’s master development plan.
  • Oversee all geotechnical investigations across the city, ensuring data integrity, consistency, and long-term value.
  • Lead the integration of all geotechnical data into Qiddiya’s GIS and digital engineering systems, ensuring long-term asset management and traceability.
  • Oversee procurement and management of city-wide geotechnical consultants and ground investigation contractors.
  • Ensure compliance with international standards, local regulations, and best practices in ground engineering.
  • Coordinate closely with district development teams to ensure geotechnical inputs are embedded in early design decisions and construction methodologies.
  • Implement a geotechnical risk register that informs prioritisation, scope development, and mitigation strategies across the project lifecycle.
  • Support the development of geotechnical specifications, scopes of work, and contract documentation to ensure consistency and technical quality across all works.

 

Cliff Stabilization Responsibilities:

  • Lead strategic planning and execution for the City-wide Cliff Stabilisation project, including the development of a phased delivery strategy that integrates with master planning, construction timelines, and the opening of adjacent districts to the cliff.
  • Progress the project through Qiddiya’s Stage Gate governance framework, leading on the development of all required Stage Gate deliverables.
  • Collaborate with the Delivery Director to design team organisational structures and implement hiring strategies
  • Collaborate with internal teams, including procurement, engineering, digital information, planning, cost planning, commercial & reporting and delivery to deliver the project objectives
  • Coordinate with district master developers to ensure seamless integration of cliff stabilisation solutions with adjacent developments.
  • Develop and maintain a cost plan in collaboration with Qiddiya’s cost planning team and external cost consultants
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and quality standards across all phases to ensure successful project delivery
  • Define and implement procurement strategies, including the identification and selection of best-fit consultants and contractors to execute the cliff stabilisation works.
  • Act as Scope Owner, contributing to all tender processes, including drafting RFPs, responding to PTCs, evaluating tenders, and responsibility for governance and approvals.
  • Implement risk management frameworks to identify potential risks and integrate mitigation strategies
  • Lead the management of technical and design consultants and oversee the deliverables, ensuring compliance with time, cost, and quality parameters
  • Oversee the review and approval process of the technical and design deliverables, ensuring alignment with Qiddiya’s Cliff Stabilisation Roadmap, engineering best practices and Qiddiya’s approval process.
  • Ensure deliverables are integrated with GIS systems to maintain a comprehensive geotechnical database for Qiddiya’s long-term cliff stability management.
  • Provide support to district developers and asset managers on cliff-related risks.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Construction Management, or a related field.
  • Minimum of 12-15 years of experience in large-scale infrastructure or development projects, with specific expertise in geotechnical and stabilisation works.
  • Proven experience in project management, contract administration, and procurement within a complex development environment.
  • Strong leadership, excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with ability to manage multidisciplinary teams and external consultants.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Governance and Stakeholder - Transport - 50008988 (HB4)
jobs.description:
The Senior manager of Stakeholder, Governance and Community engagement is a critical leadership role within the Transport Division, responsible for establishing and managing robust engagement frameworks across multi-modal transport systems that operate both within and beyond the Qiddiya boundary. The role is focused on building enduring stakeholder relationships with government, community, and industry actors, while also facilitating, deriving, agreeing and tracking transport governance and stakeholder requirements between Qiddiya Transport, internal and external governance, infrastructure and service providers.

This position requires a strategic yet hands-on leader with an exceptional stakeholder engagement capability, and significant experience navigating complex regulatory, transport governance and operational landscapes in the Middle East. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable designing stakeholder engagement templates and insights as they are negotiating internal transport governance processes and formal stakeholder agreements with senior public and private sector counterparts.

This position requires the establishment of clear communication, internal process adherence and improvement, stage gate and committee governance oversight, continuous feedback systems, and performance measurement to drive engagement effectiveness, decision enablement, compliance, and positive community sentiment.

The successful candidate is expected to cultivate a high-performance team culture focused on learning, continuous improvement, knowledge sharing, and embedding stakeholder management and governance best practices throughout the Business Unit.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Transport, Infrastructure, or related degree qualification.
  • Master’s degree in engineering management, Public Infrastructure, or similar field strongly preferred.
  • Formal training or certification in stakeholder engagement, negotiation, or interface coordination is advantageous.
  • Deep understanding of infrastructure lifecycle, transport operations, and the role of interface agreements in complex projects.
  • Outstanding interpersonal and diplomatic skills, tact and judgment, with the ability to build trust at all levels—from community members to senior government executives.
  • Strong written and verbal communication abilities in both technical and non-technical contexts.

Experience

  • Proven experience operating in the transport or related capital works sectors in the Middle East, with a detailed understanding of inter-governmental and regulatory frameworks in the region.
  • Demonstrated ability to develop stakeholder agreements from inception through execution and operational management.
  • Experience delivering or supporting large-scale, multi-modal transport projects across complex jurisdictional and physical boundaries.
  • Experience in transport project governance, performance management or PMO
  • A track record of leading and mentoring multidisciplinary teams in high-pressure environments.
  • Minimum 12–15 years of experience in transport and infrastructure projects with a strong focus on stakeholder management and coordination.
  • At least 5–7 years in a senior stakeholder-facing leadership role with significant exposure to executive-level engagement and public sector negotiations.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Health and Safety
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, HSE is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing Health, Safety, and Environmental strategies, systems, and compliance programs across projects and operations. The role ensures that all activities are performed safely, sustainably, and in accordance with applicable regulations, company policies, and international best practices.

Key Responsibilities

  • Drive a strong safety culture across projects and operational teams through leadership, coaching, and awareness programs.
  • Monitor compliance with local regulations, international standards, and company HSE requirements.
  • Oversee HSE performance across contractors, consultants, and project teams.
  • Conduct regular site inspections, audits, and compliance reviews to identify risks and ensure corrective actions are implemented.
  • Lead incident investigations, root cause analysis, and lessons learned initiatives.
  • Develop and monitor HSE KPIs, dashboards, and management reports.
  • Ensure environmental management plans are implemented, including waste management, pollution prevention, sustainability, and resource conservation initiatives.
  • Review project designs, construction methodologies, and operational activities to identify and mitigate HSE risks.
  • Manage emergency preparedness and response plans, including drills and crisis management procedures.
  • Support procurement and contract management teams on HSE requirements and contractor prequalification processes.
  • Provide regular HSE updates and recommendations to senior management.

Requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in occupational health & safety, Environmental Science, Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • 12+ years of HSE experience, including significant experience in large-scale infrastructure, construction, industrial, or mixed-use development projects.
  • Proven experience managing HSE programs across complex, multidisciplinary projects.
  • Professional certifications such as NEBOSH, IOSH, CSP, CRSP, ISO 45001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent are preferred.
  • Strong knowledge of local and international HSE regulations and best practices.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - HR Business Partner
jobs.description:
Perform business partnering by delivering tailored HR solutions for assigned divisions. Collaborate with business leaders and HR colleagues to address organizational challenges, support workforce planning, and implement HR programs. Ensure HR initiatives and policies are effectively localized and consistently applied to drive divisional and organizational objectives.

Requirements

Strategic Responsibilities

• Prepares and manages the annual budget for the HR Business Partner Department and reporting Sections in conjunction with the HR Division’s budget and tracks expenditure to ensure adherence to the budget

• Develops and implements the operating plan for the HR Business Partner Department in alignment with the HR Divisional strategic plans to ensure achievement of Qiddiya’s overall objectives

• Manages and controls the operating framework for the HR Business Partner Department, provides guidance and support, ensures implementation and review of work processes to achieve high performance standards and continuous improvement

Core Responsibilities

Strategic Leadership and Business Partnership

• Develop strategic partnerships with divisional business leaders by understanding their goals, challenges and opportunities, positioning HR as a trusted advisor.

• Champion collaboration with HR departments to integrate divisional talent strategies with business priorities.

• Evaluate divisional business-specific gaps and authorize solutions in partnership with CoEs to address employee needs.

• Define team objectives by understanding divisional business objectives and challenges to deliver tailored HR solutions.

• Lead continuous improvement initiatives by evaluating HRBP team performance, approving best practices, and driving innovation across supported divisions.

Organizational Design, Workforce Planning, and Talent Management

• Lead team efforts in organization design and workforce planning to identify talent needs in partnership with CoEs.

• Approve workforce assessments to ensure divisional workforce requirements are met.

• Establish and evaluate processes for divisional team restructuring, talent redeployment and cross-unit moves to optimize workforce agility and support business transformation.

• Oversee the localization and tailoring of HR initiatives to address unique divisional and market contexts.

HR Program Management

• Champion the consistent application of HR policies across divisions to resolve exceptions and escalations, ensuring fair treatment and effectively managing sensitive employee matters and grievances.

• Oversee the onboarding experience journey by setting expectations, approving processes, and ensuring seamless integration for new hires, resulting in alignment with organizational culture and process consistency.

• Engage actively in compensation decisions by approving discrepancy resolutions and supporting team-led conversations, ensuring fairness and equity in compensation across divisions.

• Collaborate with recruitment teams to approve exceptions and align offers with organization-wide standards, ensuring equity and consistency in employment terms.

• Set direction for divisional compensation review and role clarity processes to drive transparency, retention, and fairness of rewards across business groups.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - HSE - Racecourse (RAC-040)
jobs.description:

The successful candidate will provide strategic HSE leadership throughout the design, construction and commissioning phases, ensuring compliance with Qiddiya, PIF and Kingdom regulations, whilst driving a proactive safety culture across all contractors, consultants and project stakeholders.

This individual must possess a unique blend of client-side governance and assurance experience together with hands-on delivery experience gained with a Tier 1/Main Contractor on large-scale complex construction projects. Key Responsibilities:

HSE Leadership & Governance

  • Serve as the primary HSE advisor to the Project Director and senior leadership team.
  • Ensure compliance with all Qiddiya, PIF, regulatory authority and international best practice requirements.
  • Promote a culture of safety leadership, accountability and continuous improvement across the project.

Contractor Management

  • Racecourse and track works
  • Grandstand construction

  • Temporary works

  • Earthworks and infrastructure

  • Testing and commissioning activities

Assurance & Performance Monitoring

  • Develop and maintain project HSE dashboards and performance reporting systems.
  • Monitor leading and lagging indicators and identify emerging risks.
  • Lead incident investigations and ensure effective root cause analysis and corrective actions.
  • Produce executive-level HSE reports for senior stakeholders.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Land Cost Valuation
jobs.description:
Qiddiya Investment Company is transforming the entertainment landscape in Saudi Arabia, and we are in search of an experienced and driven professional to fill the role of Senior Manager – Land Cost and Valuations within our Master Development Unit.   • Advanced Excel and modelling capability.
  • Experience in land economics, infrastructure advisory or master development strongly preferred.
  • Strong understanding of land development lifecycle, infrastructure delivery, subdivision.
  • Understanding of principles of land valuation, cost planning and land use classifications.
  • Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
  • Excellent communication skills.
  • Ability to synthesize technical and financial inputs.
  • Strong problem-solving capability.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Landscape Design (DEL2)

The successful candidate will combine exceptional design leadership, technical expertise and project delivery experience, with a proven ability to manage complex multidisciplinary projects from concept through to construction and operational readiness. Working on the client side, the role requires a strategic and collaborative senior manager who can champion design excellence while ensuring projects are delivered safely, sustainably, efficiently and in alignment with Qiddiya's vision, values and development objectives.

The role requires extensive experience in large-scale destination developments, including land development and land servicing infrastructure, together with a strong understanding of landscape architecture, public realm design, project governance and consultant management. The Senior Design Manager will act as a key interface between internal stakeholders, external consultants and project delivery teams, ensuring that landscape and public realm solutions create memorable guest experiences, support long-term environmental resilience, and contribute positively to Qiddiya's ambition to become a global benchmark for destination development.

Requirements

Required Skills & Experience

  • Excellent analytical, problem-solving and decision-making skills.
  • Ability to balance design aspirations with operational, technical and commercial considerations.
  • Strategic mindset with the ability to identify opportunities that enhance project value and guest experience.

Communication & Management

  • Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.

  • Fluent in English, both verbal and written.

·       Chartered Landscape Architect or equivalent internationally recognised professional including-

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Leadership Development
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, Leadership Development owns the leadership curriculum end to end  from identifying what leaders need, to designing the programs that build it, to standing in the room and delivering it personally. This is a design-and-delivery role, not a design-only role: the Senior Manager is expected to facilitate sessions and coach business leaders directly, not simply commission others to do it.

The role also owns training needs analysis (TNA) for the leadership pillar, working directly with business leaders to identify capability gaps rather than relying on a separate analytics function. Depending on the department's operating model it may also directly line manage a small number of reports.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Leadership framework & curriculum design

•    Design and evolve the leadership development framework and curriculum spanning frontline supervisors through senior leaders.

•    Translate business priorities and future skills needs into concrete program design decisions, in partnership with the Director.

•    Build and run interventions using methodologies proven to drive behavioral change, including digital, blended, and experiential formats.

•    Scan industry shifts, technology, and emerging leadership practices to keep the curriculum current and competitive.

Training needs analysis

•    Own training needs analysis (TNA) for the leadership pillar  identifying leadership gaps and future capability requirements directly with business leaders.

•    Prioritize which capability gaps get addressed first based on business impact and urgency.

•    Feed TNA findings back into the leadership framework and curriculum roadmap.

Personal training delivery & coaching

•    Personally deliver leadership training sessions across levels  stay hands-on in delivery, not only design.

•    Personally coach business leaders as part of the department's coaching culture.

•    Structure and scale the internal coaching culture, including coach selection criteria and coaching standards.

•    Select and manage external facilitators, content providers, and assessment tools when specialist delivery is required.

Capability building

•    Build leadership development capability within HR Business Partners and Line Managers so expertise scales beyond the central team.

•    Design train-the-trainer approaches so select content can be co-delivered by capable Line Managers.

Requirements

•    8-10+ years in leadership, management, or executive development, with experience designing and personally delivering enterprise-wide interventions in large, complex organizations.

•    Prior experience owning training needs analysis or capability gap assessments is strongly preferred.

Educational qualifications

•    Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business Administration, or a related field.

•    Master's degree or relevant advanced HR certification (CIPD, ATD, SHRM) preferred.

Skills & competencies

•    Strong facilitation and instructional design skills; comfortable presenting to and influencing senior audiences directly.

•    Excellent stakeholder management  able to extract real needs from business leaders during TNA conversations, not just take requests at face value.

•    Strong project and budget management skills, with the ability to run multiple programs and vendors in parallel.

•    Genuine enjoyment of being in the room and delivering  this role is not a pure back-office design function.

•    External market awareness  brings outside-in thinking on leadership trends and emerging methodologies.
