jobs.title: Senior Manager - Tenancy Design Management
jobs.description:
Qiddiya is Saudi Arabia’s flagship destination for entertainment, sports, and culture — a cornerstone of Vision 2030 located just outside Riyadh. Spanning over 360 km², it will feature world-class attractions including a Formula 1-grade racetrack, theme parks, major sports venues, and performance spaces. More than a destination, Qiddiya is a catalyst for economic diversification, job creation, and a new way of life. With construction progressing rapidly, we’re looking for driven professionals ready to help shape one of the world’s most ambitious developments. Every role here has real impact — from planning and design to delivery and operations. If you're motivated by large-scale challenges and lasting legacy, there’s a place for you at Qiddiya. 

Role Purpose

The Senior Manager – Tenancy Design Management is responsible for leading district-wide tenancy design coordination, tenant integration activities, retail experience alignment, and lease-to-trade design support across assigned retail districts and developments within QIC’s retail portfolio.

The role operates across new developments, redevelopments, operational retail assets, and long-term asset evolution initiatives, supporting tenant integration, retail operability, customer experience alignment, design quality, operational readiness, and opening integration activities across the tenancy lifecycle.

Acting as the district operational lead within the tenancy design function, the role oversees district-wide tenant coordination, landlord and tenant design interface management, tenant design integration, experiential alignment, programme coordination, authority coordination support, and opening readiness activities across assigned districts.

The position is engaged from detailed design and delivery stage-gates through tenant onboarding, concept design, detailed design coordination, authority integration, fit-out integration, operational readiness, lease-to-trade activities, and ongoing operational asset support. Operating across complex multi-stakeholder environments, the role supports cross functional coordination between Development, Delivery, Leasing, Retail Design, Operations, Host BU’s, Operational Readiness, Asset Management, Legal, Finance, Relations, IT, Main Contractors, consultants, operators, tenant teams, authorities, and peer TD&D functions to ensure tenancy design activities remain operationally aligned, programme-driven, customer-focused, and integrated with district aspirations and retail objectives.

Key Responsibilities

1. District Tenancy Design Leadership & Design Coordination

 • Lead district-wide tenancy design coordination activities across assigned retail districts and tenant programmes.

• Manage tenant integration activities between tenant design proposals, landlord design requirements, district aspirations, leasing objectives, operational considerations, and customer experience expectations.
• Implement tenancy design standards, tenant-facing design guidance, retail integration methodologies, fit-out guidance principles, and lease-to-trade design practices across assigned districts and developments.
• Coordinate landlord and tenant design interface activities relating to tenant onboarding, design integration, authority coordination support, experiential alignment, operational considerations, and opening readiness requirements.
• Oversee district-wide tenancy design coordination activities relating to tenant onboarding, concept design reviews, detailed design coordination, authority interface support, fit-out integration, and operational transition activities.
• Identify, manage, and escalate operational, programme, design coordination, authority interface, experiential alignment, and tenant integration risks impacting retail operability, customer experience outcomes, district identity, or opening readiness activities across assigned districts.

2. Development Integration, Delivery Coordination & Tenant Integration
• Support tenancy design integration activities from detailed design and delivery stage-gates through operational readiness and ongoing operational asset support activities.
• Coordinate with Development, Delivery, Leasing, Operations, and Host Business Units to ensure tenancy design requirements are incorporated into programme planning, operational coordination, tenant integration activities, and district experience objectives.
• Support tenant integration planning, experiential alignment requirements, authority coordination activities, fit-out integration requirements, and opening readiness programmes during development and delivery stages.
• Support tenant design integration activities across tenant onboarding, concept design, detailed design coordination, authority submissions, fit-out integration, operational readiness, and opening activities.
• Monitor district-wide tenant coordination activities, design progress, operational readiness requirements, and opening readiness milestones across assigned districts.
• Support resolution and escalation of tenant integration, design coordination, experiential alignment, authority coordination, and delivery sequencing issues impacting retail readiness or opening programmes.

3. Cross-functional Coordination & Stakeholder Management
• Support cross-functional coordination relating to tenancy design activities across Development, Retail Design, Delivery, Leasing, Host BU’s, Operational Readiness, Asset Management, Legal, Finance, Government Relations, IT, consultants, operators, tenant teams, and authorities.
• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to support tenant integration, customer experience alignment, design coordination, authority interface activities, and opening programmes.
• Support alignment between tenancy design activities, district aspirations, operational requirements, landlord obligations, retail positioning objectives, customer experience expectations, and tenant opening programmes.
• Maintain coordination across operational readiness activities, tenant integration requirements, design coordination activities, authority interface activities, and opening readiness processes across assigned districts.
• Support district-wide coordination across peer TD&D functions to ensure alignment between tenancy design activities, technical integration, operational readiness requirements, lease-to-trade activities, and opening readiness programmes across assigned districts.
• Support implementation of tenancy design standards, retail integration methodologies, tenant-facing guidance principles, and customer experience expectations across assigned retail districts and developments.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - VCP (Vehicle Control Points) & Screening Operations
jobs.description:
The Senior Manager, VCP & Screening Operations leads QIC’s specialist screening and enhanced-security capability across vehicle access control points, pedestrian screening locations, event venues (applicable to public realm), asset openings and heightened security operations.

The role is accountable for the design input, readiness, mobilisation, performance and assurance of vehicle scanning, baggage X-ray, walk-through and hand-held metal detection, personal search, vehicle inspection, restricted-item control and secondary-screening arrangements.

The role holder ensures that scanning and screening operations are risk-based, regulatorily compliant, operationally efficient and aligned with QIC’s guest experience, workforce access and city security objectives.

Responsabilities

  • Lead the strategic development, operational planning, rollout and assurance of QIC’s scanning and screening capability across fixed VACPs, mobile scanning assets, pedestrian screening locations, event venues and elevated threat level security deployments.
  • Provide technical and operational leadership for vehicle X-ray scanning, mobile scanning, vehicle inspection, secondary search and VACP operations, including equipment capability, throughput, staffing model and operational constraints.
  • Plan and oversee walk-through metal detection, hand-held metal detection, baggage X-ray, bag search, personal search and secondary-screening arrangements across permanent, temporary and event-based deployments.
  • Own the governance, management and execution of restricted-item controls across permanent and temporary screening operations.
  • Develop and implement risk-based screening uplift strategies that support major events, VIP/VVIP activity, asset activations and heightened threat conditions, ensuring security capabilities are scalable, proportionate and operationally effective.
  • Plan and coordinate cross-functional readiness across assets, city leadership, operational stakeholders and delivery partners to ensure infrastructure, workforce, technology and support requirements are ready to activate scanning and screening operations at scale across a complex geographical landscape.
  • Coordinate specialist security support requirements, including K9 capabilities, government interfaces and technology teams to ensure effective operational readiness and delivery.
  • Ensure incidents, exercises, audits and live deployments drive SOP updates and future planning improvements.
  • Manage the scanning asset lifecycle, using operational and maintenance data to inform replacement planning, preventative maintenance programmes, fleet health and operational readiness.
  • Maintain operator authorisations, specialist training, refresher requirements and equipment competence records.
  • Provide operational input into procurement, design changes and future scanning technology requirements.
  • Manage contractor performance against KPIs, SLAs, manpower plans, technical obligations and readiness requirements.
  • Raise, track and close NCRs, corrective actions and repeated performance failures.
  • Lead site inspections, readiness checks, audits and operational reviews to verify deployment readiness, contractor performance and compliance with approved operating requirements.
  • Identify operational, commercial and capability gaps, agree corrective actions with contractors, vendors and internal stakeholders, and support the Director in scaling the capability through commercially viable delivery models.
  • Work with City Ops Verticals, Event Operators, Asset Owners/Operators and Delivery / Development (construction coordination).
  • Align scanning operations with workforce access, vehicle access, guest flows and asset operating requirements.
  • Provide expert advice on scanning design, operational constraints, guest impact and threat-based deployment requirements.
  • Produce readiness, performance, incident, restricted-item and improvement reports.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent recognised qualification in Security Management, Security and Risk Management, Aviation Security, Emergency Management Operations Management or a related discipline.
  • Extensive experience planning and leading vehicle and individual screening operations in complex, high-volume, geographically dispersed or high-risk environments.
  • Practical leadership experience with vehicle X-ray scanning, mobile scanning, vehicle inspection, secondary search, fixed VACP operations and restricted-item controls.
  • Experience planning and managing walk-through metal detection, hand-held metal detection, baggage X-ray, bag search, personal search and secondary screening across permanent and temporary deployments.
  • Experience in airports, border security, critical infrastructure, large public venues, giga-projects, government facilities or national-security operating environments.
  • Strong experience managing specialist security contractors, KPI and SLA performance, NCRs, corrective actions, audits, operational readiness and value-for-money challenge.
  • Proven ability to lead live operations during high-attendance periods, major events, VIP/VVIP activity and elevated threat conditions.
  • Demonstrated ability to operate within a complex stakeholder environment, balancing competing priorities and expectations to achieve strategic and operational outcomes.

jobs.title: Senior Manager - Worker Welfare (DEL 3)
jobs.description:
Job Summary

Lead and manage worker welfare across Qiddiya's operational environment, ensuring safe, healthy, dignified and compliant living and working conditions for employees, contractors and service providers operating within Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, precincts, events and public realm environments.

Own the development, implementation and assurance of city-wide worker welfare standards, management systems and improvement programmes covering accommodation, transport, catering and food services, hygiene, recreation, wellbeing and workforce support services. Provide operational oversight of welfare performance across multiple assets and service providers, ensuring compliance with applicable legal, regulatory, client and Qiddiya requirements.

Partner closely with Operations, Operational Readiness, Facilities Management, HSE, HR, Security, Transport, Procurement and contractor organizations to identify welfare risks, drive corrective actions, support mobilisation and readiness activities, investigate concerns and continuously improve workforce wellbeing outcomes across the city portfolio.

Roles and Responsibilities

Worker Welfare Governance

• Develop, implement, maintain and continuously improve the Qiddiya City Operations Worker Welfare Framework, standards, procedures, management plans and assurance programs.

• Own and maintain the Worker Welfare Management Plan for operational assets and city-wide operations, ensuring consistent implementation across all locations, shifts, service providers and contractors.

• Ensure worker welfare requirements are integrated into operational policies, contractor management processes, mobilisation activities and operational risk management programs.

• Provide subject matter expertise on worker welfare, labor standards and workforce wellbeing matters across City Operations.

Operational Assurance & Compliance

• Lead a risk-based programme of inspections, audits and assurance activities covering accommodation, welfare facilities, transport, sanitation, water quality, pest control, housekeeping, recreational facilities, wellbeing services and workforce support arrangements.

• Lead assurance of contractor and service provider compliance with Qiddiya Worker Welfare Standards through inspections, audits, performance reviews and evidence-based verification activities.

• Monitor corrective actions arising from audits, inspections, complaints and investigations and ensure timely, evidenced closure.

• Maintain readiness for internal, client and regulatory inspections through effective governance, reporting and record management.

Contractor & Service Provider Management

• Manage welfare-related contractors and service providers, including accommodation operators, Facilities Management providers, transport contractors, catering providers, cleaning services, security providers and other workforce support functions.

• Define welfare requirements, service expectations, SLAs, KPIs and performance standards within contracts and service agreements.

• Lead contractor and vendor performance reviews relating to worker welfare and workforce wellbeing, and drive corrective and preventive actions.

• Support Procurement and Contractor Management teams during contractor onboarding, mobilisation and ongoing assurance activities.

Operational Readiness & Asset Handover

• Support operational readiness, mobilisation and asset handover programmes by ensuring worker welfare requirements are incorporated into design reviews, commissioning, mobilisation and go-live activities.

• Review workforce accommodation, transport, welfare facilities and support arrangements for new operational assets and services before commencement.

• Participate in readiness reviews, stage-gate approvals and operational assurance activities to verify worker welfare controls are in place before assets or services become operational.

• Ensure welfare considerations are included within contingency planning and emergency preparedness arrangements.

Events & Temporary Workforce Welfare

• Provide worker welfare oversight and assurance for temporary, seasonal and event-related workforces operating across Qiddiya-controlled assets, venues, events and public realm environments.

• Ensure appropriate welfare arrangements are established for major events, peak operational periods and contractor mobilisation activities.

• Monitor and address welfare risks associated with extended working hours, heat stress, transport, accommodation, temporary facilities and workforce support arrangements.

Grievance Management & Workforce Engagement

• Operate and oversee worker welfare grievance, escalation and reporting mechanisms, including accessible and confidential reporting channels.

• Ensure concerns are triaged, investigated and closed promptly, fairly and consistently, with appropriate corrective actions and records.

• Analyse trends, identify systemic issues and implement preventative measures to improve workforce wellbeing outcomes.

• Promote worker engagement, awareness and wellbeing initiatives across operational environments and contractor workforces.

Performance Reporting & Continuous Improvement

• Develop and maintain city-wide worker welfare dashboards, KPIs and performance reports covering audit results, accommodation compliance, grievance trends, heat stress controls, contractor compliance, workforce engagement, service quality, non-conformances and corrective action closure.

• Provide regular performance, risk and assurance reports to Operations leadership and relevant governance forums, including client updates where required.

• Chair or participate in management reviews with Operations, Facilities Management and service providers.

• Use performance data, benchmarking, worker feedback and assurance findings to drive continuous improvement across City Operations.

Leadership & People Management

• Lead and develop the worker welfare team across multiple operational locations and assets, setting clear roles, accountabilities and escalation arrangements.

• Establish competency, training and development programmes for welfare personnel and ensure effective coverage across the city portfolio.

• Build strong relationships with internal stakeholders, contractors, regulators and external service providers to improve worker welfare outcomes.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Social Sciences, Public Health, Occupational Health & Safety, Facilities Management, Hospitality Management or a related discipline.

• Training or certification in worker welfare, labour standards, social compliance, HSE, auditing or facilities management, such as social compliance auditor training, NEBOSH, IOSH or ISO auditing, is preferred.

• 7+ years of experience in worker welfare, accommodation or camp operations, social compliance, facilities or property operations, or workforce services within large, multi-site operational environments.

• Experience supporting worker welfare programmes within large-scale mixed-use destinations, cities, airports, transport networks, entertainment venues, hospitality environments, operational assets or similar complex operational environments is preferred.

• Demonstrated capability in multi-site auditing, evidence-based close-out of corrective actions, vendor and SLA management, grievance handling, contractor assurance, stakeholder engagement and performance reporting.

• Experience supporting operational readiness, mobilisation, asset handover, major events or peak operational periods is preferred.

• Proactive, self-directed and able to work independently across a dispersed portfolio, using initiative to identify issues early, drive improvements and follow through to closure.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Cloud Center of Excellence
jobs.description:

Support and governs cloud financial management practices to ensure cloud spending is transparent, controlled, and aligned with organizational financial objectives.

The role enables cost visibility, budgeting, forecasting, and optimization by providing reporting, cost allocation mechanisms, and advisory to application teams, platform engineering, and cloud operations teams to improve cost efficiency.

·       Configure and manage cloud budget alerts to monitor spending and notify stakeholders when consumption approaches defined thresholds.

·       Publish and maintain cloud cost dashboards and reports to provide visibility into cloud spend, consumption trends, and cost drivers.

·       Implement and maintain cloud cost allocation and showback mechanisms to attribute cloud spending to assets, departments and applications.

Support annual departmental financial planning and budgeting activities.

Requirements

Minimum Qualifications:

Bachelor’s degree in MIS, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is required.

Master’s degree in MIS, Information Technology, Engineering or equivalent from a recognized and accredited university is preferred.

Years of Experience:

3+ years in a relevant industry, preferably with majority in IT financial operations, budgeting and cost allocation

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Data Engineering
jobs.description:
As a Senior Data Engineer, you will use various methods to transform raw data into useful data systems.

Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to ensure the availability, reliability, and accessibility of data

for analytics and decision-making purposes. Overall, you’ll strive for efficiency by aligning data systems with

business goals.

To succeed in this data engineering position, you should have strong analytical skills and the ability to

combine data from different sources. Data engineer skills also include familiarity with several programming

languages and knowledge of learning machine methods.

Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain scalable data pipelines and ETL processes using tools such as Apache Spark, Apache Kafka, and Apache Airflow to ingest, process, and transform large volumes of data from various sources.
  • Deploy Data Pipeline on different Data Processing Product - DataFlow (Apache Beam), DataProc (Hadoop/Spark), Data Fusion, Cloud Composer(Airflow)
  • Building distributed systems and data stores
  • Collaborating with and supporting data science, marketing, and customer success teams in data acquisition and tool integration
  • Configuration of Google Cloud Platform services
  • Implement and optimize data storage solutions, including data warehouses (e.g., Amazon Redshift, Google BigQuery), data lakes (e.g., AWS S3, Azure Data Lake Storage), and NoSQL databases (e.g., MongoDB, Cassandra).
  • Work closely with data architects to design and implement efficient data models using dimensional modeling techniques (e.g., star schema, snowflake schema) that support business requirements and enable effective data analysis.
  • Collaborate with data scientists and analysts to understand data requirements and develop solutions to support advanced analytics and machine learning initiatives, including model training and deployment.
  • Implement data quality checks, monitoring and custom scripts to ensure the accuracy, completeness, and reliability of data.
  • Participate in troubleshooting and resolving data-related issues, ensuring timely resolution and minimal disruption to business operations.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Distribution
jobs.description:

This execution-focused role ensures that all of Qiddiya's bookable products are accurately listed, competitively priced, and performing optimally across all active distribution touchpoints. The incumbent works closely with the Senior Manager – Distribution and interfaces with OTA platform contacts, technology vendors, and internal teams to maintain a high-functioning, revenue-generating distribution network.

Requirements

1. OTA Account Operations & Optimisation

•      Manage the daily operations of Qiddiya's OTA accounts across all active platforms (Booking.com, Expedia, Almosafer, Booking.sa, etc.) — including content updates, rate loading, availability management, and promotional activations.

•      Monitor OTA content quality scores, review ratings, and listing rankings, implementing optimisation actions to maintain top-tier platform positioning.

•      Coordinate OTA promotional campaigns with the Senior Manager and Marketing team, including flash sales, early-bird promotions, and platform-exclusive offers.

•      Manage OTA extranet access, user permissions, and reporting configurations for all active platforms.

•      Serve as the primary operational point of contact for OTA platform representatives on day-to-day issues.

2. GDS Configuration & Channel Management

•      Manage Qiddiya's GDS content, rate loading, and availability across Amadeus, Sabre, and Galileo platforms — ensuring accurate, bookable inventory is maintained at all times.

•      Configure and maintain the Channel Management System (CMS), ensuring seamless two-way connectivity between Qiddiya's Central Reservation System (CRS) and all active distribution channels.

•      Monitor and resolve channel connectivity issues, rate parity violations, and inventory discrepancies in a timely manner.

•      Support the onboarding of new GDS channels and technology integrations as directed by the Senior Manager.

•      Ensure GDS booking agent codes, commission rates, and special corporate rates are correctly configured and maintained.

3. Trade Partner Portal & B2B Platform Support

•      Manage the day-to-day operations of the Qiddiya Trade Partner Portal — including user access management, content updates, booking tool configuration, and partner query resolution.

•      Onboard new trade partners onto the portal, providing setup guidance, training, and ongoing technical support.

•      Monitor portal usage metrics and booking activity, flagging underperforming partners or technical issues to the Senior Manager.

•      Coordinate portal content updates with Marketing to ensure all partner-facing materials (rate sheets, product descriptions, promotional offers) are current and accurate.

•      Gather partner feedback on portal usability and work with the Technology team to implement improvements.

4. Pricing, Rate Parity & Inventory Management

•      Load and manage contracted rates, promotional rates, and dynamic pricing parameters across all distribution channels in coordination with the Senior Manager.

•      Conduct daily rate parity checks across OTA and direct channels, identifying and resolving any discrepancies immediately.

•      Monitor booking pace, cancellation patterns, and demand indicators, providing data-driven inputs to support pricing decisions.

•      Manage allotment releases, blackout dates, and special event inventory configurations across all channels.

•      Maintain an accurate rate and inventory audit log, ensuring all changes are documented and traceable.

5. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

•      Produce daily and weekly channel performance reports covering booking volumes, revenue by channel, OTA rankings, rate parity status, and conversion rates.

•      Maintain and update the distribution performance dashboard, ensuring accurate, real-time data is available to the Senior Manager and Senior Director.

•      Conduct monthly channel performance analysis identifying trends, anomalies, and optimisation opportunities across all active distribution channels.

•      Support the Senior Manager in preparing commercial reporting for monthly operations reviews and Quarterly Business Reviews.

•      Track and report on competitor pricing and distribution positioning, providing market intelligence to inform Qiddiya's distribution strategy.

Qualifications

Experience Requirements

•      Minimum 5–7 years of experience in distribution management, channel management, or revenue operations within a hotel group, OTA, destination, or travel technology company.

•      Hands-on operational experience managing OTA extranets (Booking.com, Expedia) and GDS platforms (Amadeus, Sabre, Galileo).

•      Experience working with Channel Management Systems (CMS) and Central Reservation Systems (CRS).

•      Strong background in rate management, inventory management, and distribution reporting.

•      GCC / Middle East distribution experience is preferred.

Core Competencies & Skills

•      Deep technical knowledge of OTA extranet platforms and GDS configuration.

•      Proficiency with Channel Management Systems (SiteMinder, Cloudbeds, or similar).

•      Strong data and reporting skills — proficiency in Excel, Power BI, or equivalent BI tools.

•      High attention to detail, particularly in rate loading, inventory management, and data accuracy.

•      Strong problem-solving and troubleshooting skills for distribution system issues.

•      Good communication skills in English; Arabic language proficiency is advantageous.

jobs.title: Senior Specialist - Training Administration - (CDU-029) 50012690
jobs.description:
General Summary

Qiddiya City is an exciting new destination city right on the doorstep of Riyadh, Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The city plan will include 25 distinct masterplan districts across sports, entertainment, arts and culture, and mixed-use areas, residential communities and nature. Qiddiya City will eventually be home to more than 600,000 residents and host millions of visitors and experience seekers yearly.

The Sales and Leasing Performance Unit (PLU) within Qiddiya is responsible for developing best practice sales and leasing standards and expertise within the organisation. At the heart of this unit sits the Qiddiya Real Estate LearnLab (QREL), a digital-first, gamified learning academy, designed to drive measurable commercial capability development across the Sales and Leasing function.

The Senior Specialist – Training Administration role reports directly to the Senior Manager, Digital Systems. This role is the operational backbone of the learning platform, aimed at ensuring that learners are correctly configured, content is accurately published and maintained, training schedules are coordinated, and learning data is surfaced in a meaningful and timely way through dashboards and reporting.

About the Role/Project Scope

This is a highly organised, detail-oriented, and platform management role that requires a strong working knowledge of LMS/LXP administration, digital content authoring, data and dashboard management, and learner coordination. The Senior Specialist – Training Administration will work closely with the other teams of the Qiddiya Real Estate LearnLab (QREL) to ensure the platform runs smoothly, learners receive a seamless experience, and senior stakeholders have the operational data it needs to make informed decisions.

 

Key Responsibilities

LMS/LXP Administration and Learner Account Management

•     Serve as the day-to-day LMS/LXP administrator for the Qiddiya Real Estate LearnLab online academy, managing all learner-facing configuration across internal and external learner audience.

•     Create, manage, and maintain learner accounts in Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP, including user provisioning, role assignment, cohort allocation, and access management across all active learning programmes.

•     Process new learner onboarding requests, ensuring accurate data entry, correct role tagging, and timely account activation so that learners can access their assigned programmes without delay.

•     Manage learner enrollments, unenrollment, and transfers between programmes and cohorts in Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP, maintaining an accurate and up-to-date learner register at all times.

•     Configure and maintain smart groups, learning paths, and auto-enrolment rules within Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP to ensure learners are automatically directed to the correct content based on their role, BU, and cohort.

•     Administer completion certificates and badge awards within Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP, ensuring all gamification mechanics including points allocation, badge triggers, and leaderboard entries fire correctly and are verified against test results.

•     Troubleshoot learner access issues, SCORM loading errors, completion tracking failures, and platform navigation problems, escalating to the Senior Manager, Digital Systems where platform-level resolution is required.

•     Maintain the QREL learner database as a live and accurate record, auditing regularly for duplicate accounts, inactive users, or misassigned roles.

Training Schedule Coordination and Programme Administration

•     Coordinate and manage the QREL training calendar, scheduling live learning sessions, instructor-led workshops, onboarding events, and assessment windows across all cohorts and BU audiences.

•     Send calendar invitations, pre-session communications, joining instructions, and preparation materials to learners and facilitators ahead of scheduled training sessions.

•     Track attendance and participation for all live and scheduled training events, maintaining accurate session records and flagging non-attendance to the relevant Anchor or BU lead.

•     Coordinate logistics for in-person training sessions including room booking, materials preparation, equipment checks, and facilitator support where required.

•     Maintain a forward-looking training schedule that is shared with the DS team, Learner Experience team, Programs team, and relevant BU stakeholders on a regular basis.

•     Manage training waitlists, cohort capacity, and scheduling conflicts, escalating prioritisation decisions to the Senior Manager, Digital Systems where required.

•     Support post-training administration including assessment distribution, feedback survey deployment, and completion record updates in Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP following live sessions.

 

Content Authoring and Publishing in LMS/LXP

•     Author, build, and publish learning content within Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP using the platform's native authoring tools, including course builder, module cards, scenario cards, question cards, survey cards, and reflection prompts.

•     Support the production of bite-sized digital learning assets in LMS/LXP including knowledge checks, pre-assessments, placement tests, and spaced repetition review cards aligned to the QREL content architecture.

•     Apply and maintain the QREL metadata taxonomy across all published content in LMS/LXP, ensuring every module carries the correct realm tag, skill tag, language tag, audience tag, and content type classification.

•     Manage content version control in LMS/LXP, archiving outdated or superseded modules correctly to protect completion records and learner history while keeping the active content catalogue clean and accurate.

•     Conduct regular content audits within the LMS/LXP catalogue to identify and resolve tagging errors, broken SCORM links, incorrect completion criteria, or sequencing issues.

•     Coordinate with the Programs team and Accenture on the timely receipt of SCORM files, reviewing each upload against the content acceptance criteria before publishing to the live environment.

Dashboard Management and Reporting

•     Build, maintain, and update QREL learning dashboards within LMS/LXP Insights and Power BI, ensuring that real-time and periodic reports are available to the DS team, Learner Experience team, BU Training Leads, and senior stakeholders.

•     Produce regular operational reports covering learner completion rates, module engagement, assessment scores, at-risk learner flags, and platform activity volumes, distributing these to the relevant stakeholders on an agreed reporting cadence.

•     Monitor Qiddiya’s LMS/LXP Insights on a daily and weekly basis, identifying completion gaps, engagement drops, or data anomalies and escalating to the Senior Manager, Digital Systems with a clear summary and recommended action.

•     Maintain the four-view QREL reporting suite — Learning Administrator, BU Training Lead, Senior Stakeholders, and Performance Team — ensuring dashboards are accurate, up to date, and aligned to the agreed KPI framework.

•     Track and report on platform health metrics including login frequency, session duration, active learner counts, at-risk content flags, and notification open rates, providing weekly summaries to the Senior Manager, Digital Systems.

•     Ensure all learner data and reporting outputs are handled in accordance with QREL data governance standards and Qiddiya's data privacy requirements.

Stakeholder Coordination and Communication

•     Act as the first point of contact for learner queries, access issues, and platform questions, responding promptly and escalating to the Manager/Senior Manager, Digital Systems and or other teams respectively, where platform-level intervention is needed.

•     Liaise with BU Training Leads and Anchors to communicate training schedules, completion deadlines, assessment requirements, and learner progress updates on a regular basis.

•     Coordinate with the Learner Experience (LX) team to ensure learner-facing communications, including launch announcements, welcome messages, and campaign content, are aligned to the QREL brand and distributed through the correct channels.

•     Work closely with the Programs and LX teams to ensure content is published correctly, learner pathways are configured accurately, and the learner experience is delivered consistently across every cohort and learning area.

•     Support the Senior Manager, Digital Systems in preparing materials, data summaries, and status updates for internal meetings, Steerco sessions, and vendor reviews.

Requirements

Skills and Attributes required/ desired

Essential (must have to perform the role):

•     Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, Learning and Development, Education, or a related field.

•     Minimum 3 to 5 years of professional experience in a learning administration, LMS/LXP management, or digital learning operations role, preferably in a large organization.

•     Demonstrated working knowledge in managing a LMS/LXP (for examples Sana, Cornerstone, etc), including learner account management, content publishing, enrolment configuration, and reporting.

•     Experience uploading, configuring, and troubleshooting SCORM content within an LMS/LXP environment.

•     Proficiency in building and maintaining dashboards and reports using LMS/LXP Insights, Power BI, or equivalent data visualisation tools.

•     Strong organisational skills with a high degree of accuracy and attention to detail in data entry, account management, and content configuration.

•     Working knowledge of digital learning authoring tools (Articulate/Elucidat/Mindsmith/Genially/iSpring/etc) or equivalent  

•     Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English. Arabic proficiency is an advantage.

•     Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to coordinate effectively across multiple teams and stakeholders.

•     Ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously and prioritise effectively in a fast-paced environment.

•     High proficiency in Microsoft 365 including SharePoint, Teams, Excel, and PowerPoint.

Desirable (advantageous):

•     Prior experience working within a Sales and Leasing, real estate, or commercial capability development environment.

•     Familiarity with gamification mechanics in a learning platform context, including points, badges, leaderboards, and progress-based unlocking.

•     Experience producing or administering bilingual English and Arabic learning content, including familiarity with right-to-left formatting and Arabic SCORM testing.

•     Experience working within a parent-child LMS/LXP node structure or multi-entity learning environment.

 

Preferred Background and experience

•     Proven track record as an LMS/LXP administrator in a mid-to-large organisation, managing learner populations across multiple cohorts, business units, or geographies.

•     Experience managing LMS/LXP or an equivalent platform as a named administrator, with responsibility for end-to-end platform governance including user management, content publishing, and reporting.

•     Background in digital learning operations, with hands-on experience building and publishing content using native LMS authoring tools and SCORM-based modules.

•     Demonstrated experience producing and managing learning dashboards and data reports for multiple stakeholder audiences.

•     Track record of coordinating training schedules and programme logistics across a large and geographically distributed learner population.

Experience working within a structured content governance and metadata tagging framework.

jobs.description:
The Theme Park & Attractions Maintenance programme is a comprehensive offering aimed at equipping participants with the necessary skills for maintaining safe and operational environments in visitor attractions.

Participants will develop essential maintenance skills, including adherence to safety protocols, conducting routine inspections, and performing both preventive and corrective maintenance. The course covers the theoretical foundations of equipment safety, combined with hands-on technical training in ride maintenance and repair. Through a blend of classroom instruction, practical exercises, and case studies, participants will gain the confidence and expertise needed to maintain the safe and efficient operation of theme park attractions.

Requirements

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Saudi National
  • Education: Diploma or higher Degree
  • Years of experience: Not applicable
  • Availability: Full-time availability and commitment to attend the entire programme
  • Required documents: CV

jobs.title: Theme Park and Attractions Operations Training Course
jobs.description:
The Theme Park and Attractions Operations programme is a comprehensive offering designed to introduce aspiring professionals to the dynamic world of visitor attractions.

Participants will receive foundational knowledge and practical insights into the diverse roles within visitor attractions, preparing them for line staff positions across various operational functions. The curriculum covers the full spectrum of attraction operations, from understanding business models and guest service excellence to mastering the intricacies of area operations and safety management.

Through a blend of classroom instruction, case studies, and role-playing exercises, participants will develop the skills and confidence needed to thrive as entry-level operators in the fast-paced, customer-centric environment of visitor attractions.

Requirements

Eligibility Criteria

  • Nationality: Saudi National
  • Education: High School degree or higher
  • Years of experience: Not applicable
  • Availability: Full-time availability and commitment to attend the entire programme
  • Required Documents: CV
